source.text: וַיְהִ֧י לִֽיהוֹשָׁפָ֛ט עֹ֥שֶׁר וְכָב֖וֹד לָרֹ֑ב וַיִּתְחַתֵּ֖ן לְאַחְאָֽב׃

records.literal_gloss: And was to Jehoshaphat riches and honor in abundance, and he made himself [a] son-in-law to Ahab.

en.L: And Jehoshaphat had riches and honor in abundance, and he allied himself by marriage with Ahab.
en.B: Jehoshaphat had great riches and honor, and he made a marriage alliance with Ahab.
en.R: Jehoshaphat was very rich and highly honored. He also made an alliance with Ahab through a marriage between their families.

es.L: Y tuvo Josafat riquezas y gloria en abundancia, y emparentó con Acab.
es.B: Josafat tuvo grandes riquezas y gloria, e hizo una alianza matrimonial con Acab.
es.R: Josafat era muy rico y muy honrado. También hizo una alianza con Acab por medio de un matrimonio entre sus familias.

fr.L: Et Josaphat eut des richesses et de la gloire en abondance, et il s’allia par mariage avec Achab.
fr.B: Josaphat eut de grandes richesses et beaucoup de gloire, et il conclut une alliance par mariage avec Achab.
fr.R: Josaphat était très riche et très honoré. Il a aussi fait alliance avec Achab par un mariage entre leurs familles.

sw.L: Yehoshafati alikuwa na utajiri na heshima kwa wingi, akajifanya mkwe wa Ahabu.
sw.B: Yehoshafati alikuwa na utajiri mwingi na heshima kubwa, naye akafanya mapatano ya ndoa na Ahabu.
sw.R: Yehoshafati alikuwa tajiri sana na mwenye heshima kubwa. Alifanya pia muungano na Ahabu kwa njia ya ndoa kati ya jamaa zao.

vi.L: Giô-sa-phát có giàu có và vinh hiển rất nhiều, và ông kết thông gia với A-háp.
vi.B: Giô-sa-phát rất giàu có và vinh hiển, và vua kết liên minh thông gia với A-háp.
vi.R: Giô-sa-phát rất giàu có và được tôn trọng. Vua cũng kết liên minh với A-háp bằng một cuộc hôn nhân giữa hai hoàng gia.

ko.L: 그리고 여호사밧에게 부와 영예가 많았고, 그가 아합과 혼인으로 동맹을 맺었다.
ko.B: 여호사밧은 큰 부와 영예를 누렸고, 혼인을 통해 아합과 동맹을 맺었다.
ko.R: 여호사밧은 아주 부유했고 큰 존경을 받았다. 그는 또 두 집안이 혼인을 맺게 하여 아합과 동맹을 맺었다.

pt.L: E Josafá teve riquezas e honra em abundância, e se aparentou com Acabe por casamento.
pt.B: Josafá tinha grandes riquezas e honra, e fez uma aliança de casamento com Acabe.
pt.R: Josafá era muito rico e muito honrado. Ele também fez uma aliança com Acabe por meio de um casamento entre as duas famílias.

decisions.choice: Chronicles' own opening to the story told in 1 Kings 22:1-35
decisions.reason: This chapter retells 1 Kings 22:1-35, the campaign against Ramoth-gilead and the death of Ahab, mostly in the same words. Chronicles leaves out 1 Kings 22:1 (three years without war between Aram and Israel) and opens instead with this verse, which has no parallel in Kings. It repeats Jehoshaphat's riches and honor from 17:5 and adds his marriage alliance with Ahab. The notes on each verse below name where the Hebrew differs from Kings.

decisions.choice: made himself a son-in-law to Ahab: joined his royal house to Ahab's by a marriage
decisions.reason: The verb means to become related by marriage (Deuteronomy 7:3; 1 Kings 3:1). The marriage was between their children: Jehoshaphat's son Jehoram married Ahab's daughter Athaliah (21:6; 22:2; 2 Kings 8:18, 26). Marriages between royal houses sealed alliances between kingdoms.

decisions.choice: riches and honor ... and he allied himself: the alliance set beside his strength
decisions.reason: The verse puts the two facts side by side. After chapter 17 has shown how Yahweh made Jehoshaphat strong and rich (17:5), the alliance with Ahab may be meant to look needless. A prophet later rebukes him for helping Ahab (19:2). The Hebrew only says "and", so the contrast is implied, not stated.

decisions.choice: through a marriage between their families
decisions.reason: Readable says that the alliance was made by a marriage between the two royal families (m2), since "made himself a son-in-law" would suggest that Jehoshaphat himself married into Ahab's family.

decisions.choice: "emparentó con" (L); "hizo una alianza matrimonial" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The verb means to become related by marriage (meaning decision); as the Spanish of 1 Kings 3:1 for Solomon and Pharaoh.

decisions.choice: the French Kings wording of 1 Kings 22 reused through the chapter; "Achab"
decisions.reason: The chapter retells 1 Kings 22:1-35 mostly in the same words (m1), so every level keeps the French of 1 Kings 22 and changes only where the Hebrew of Chronicles differs (the feast in verse 2, "God" in verse 5, "my God" in verse 13, the plural "you" in verses 14 and 18, Yahweh's help in verse 31, and others).

decisions.choice: akajifanya mkwe wa Ahabu (Literal); mapatano ya ndoa (Balanced); muungano ... kwa njia ya ndoa (Readable)
decisions.reason: The verb means to become related by marriage, as in the Swahili 1 Kings 3:1 ("akajifanya mkwe wa Farao"); Ahab is "Ahabu", as the terms note.

decisions.choice: "kết thông gia"; the wording of 1 Kings 22:1-35 through the chapter
decisions.reason: The marriage alliance (m2) uses the word of 1 Kings 3:1. The story that follows is 1 Kings 22:2-35, and the Vietnamese of Kings is kept at each level with its address forms: the kings say "tôi" and "vua" to each other; prophets call the king "vua" (B, R "đức vua" where the English says "Your Majesty"); Ahab says "ta" and "ông" to Micaiah.

decisions.choice: "혼인으로 동맹을 맺었다"; Readable adds "두 집안이 혼인을 맺게 하여"
decisions.reason: The verb means to become related by marriage; Readable says how, as the English does.

decisions.choice: riquezas e honra; se aparentou com Acabe por casamento (L), uma aliança de casamento (B, R); Acabe
decisions.reason: "Riquezas e honra" as in 17:5 and 1:11-12 (m3 there). The verb means to become related by marriage (m2); Literal says "se aparentou", which, unlike "tornou-se genro", does not make Jehoshaphat himself the bridegroom. The chapter retells 1 Kings 22:1-35 (m1), and from verse 3 on each verse keeps the Portuguese of its parallel where the Hebrew is the same, with "Acabe", "Micaías, filho de Inlá", "Ramote-Gileade" and "Zedequias, filho de Quenaaná" as there.

source.text: וַיֵּרֶד֩ לְקֵ֨ץ שָׁנִ֤ים אֶל־אַחְאָב֙ לְשֹׁ֣מְר֔וֹן וַיִּֽזְבַּֽח־ל֨וֹ אַחְאָ֜ב צֹ֤אן וּבָקָר֙ לָרֹ֔ב וְלָעָ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר עִמּ֑וֹ וַיְסִיתֵ֕הוּ לַעֲל֖וֹת אֶל־רָמ֥וֹת גִּלְעָֽד׃

records.literal_gloss: And he went down at [the] end of years to Ahab to Samaria, and slaughtered for him Ahab sheep and cattle in abundance, and for the people who [were] with him, and he enticed him to go up against Ramoth-gilead.

en.L: And at [the] end of [some] years he went down to Ahab, to Samaria. And Ahab slaughtered sheep and cattle in abundance for him and for the people who [were] with him, and he enticed him to go up against Ramoth-gilead.
en.B: Some years later he went down to visit Ahab in Samaria. Ahab slaughtered sheep and cattle in great numbers for him and for the people who were with him, and he urged him to go up against Ramoth-gilead.
en.R: Some years later, Jehoshaphat went to visit Ahab in the city of Samaria. Ahab killed a great many sheep and cattle to hold a feast for him and for the people with him. And Ahab urged Jehoshaphat to join him in attacking the city of Ramoth-gilead.

es.L: Y al cabo de [algunos] años descendió a Acab, a Samaria. Y Acab mató para él ovejas y bueyes en abundancia, y para el pueblo que [estaba] con él, y lo indujo a subir contra Ramot de Galaad.
es.B: Algunos años después bajó a visitar a Acab en Samaria. Acab mató muchas ovejas y bueyes para él y para la gente que lo acompañaba, y lo persuadió a subir contra Ramot de Galaad.
es.R: Algunos años después, Josafat fue a visitar a Acab en la ciudad de Samaria. Acab mató muchísimas ovejas y bueyes para hacer un banquete en su honor y en honor de la gente que lo acompañaba. Y Acab convenció a Josafat de que lo acompañara a atacar la ciudad de Ramot de Galaad.

fr.L: Et au bout de [quelques] années, il descendit vers Achab à Samarie. Et Achab tua pour lui et pour le peuple qui [était] avec lui du petit et du gros bétail en abondance, et il le persuada de monter contre Ramoth de Galaad.
fr.B: Quelques années plus tard, il descendit rendre visite à Achab à Samarie. Achab tua pour lui et pour les gens qui l’accompagnaient des moutons et des bœufs en grand nombre, et il le pressa de monter contre Ramoth de Galaad.
fr.R: Quelques années plus tard, Josaphat est allé rendre visite à Achab dans la ville de Samarie. Achab a tué un très grand nombre de moutons et de bœufs pour offrir un festin à lui et aux gens qui l’accompagnaient. Et Achab a insisté pour que Josaphat l’aide à attaquer la ville de Ramoth de Galaad.

sw.L: Mwisho wa miaka [kadhaa] akashuka kwa Ahabu huko Samaria. Ahabu akachinja kondoo na ng'ombe kwa wingi kwa ajili yake na kwa ajili ya watu waliokuwa pamoja naye, akamshawishi apande kupigana na Ramoth-gileadi.
sw.B: Miaka kadhaa baadaye alishuka kumtembelea Ahabu huko Samaria. Ahabu akachinja kondoo na ng'ombe wengi kwa ajili yake na kwa ajili ya watu waliokuwa pamoja naye, akamhimiza apande kupigana na Ramoth-gileadi.
sw.R: Miaka kadhaa baadaye, Yehoshafati alikwenda kumtembelea Ahabu katika mji wa Samaria. Ahabu akachinja kondoo na ng'ombe wengi sana ili kumfanyia karamu yeye na watu waliokuwa pamoja naye. Kisha Ahabu akamhimiza Yehoshafati waungane kuushambulia mji wa Ramoth-gileadi.

vi.L: Cuối [mấy] năm sau, ông đi xuống thăm A-háp tại Sa-ma-ri. A-háp giết chiên và bò thật nhiều cho ông và cho những người đi với ông, và dụ ông đi lên đánh Ra-mốt Ga-la-át.
vi.B: Vài năm sau, Giô-sa-phát đi xuống thăm A-háp tại Sa-ma-ri. A-háp làm thịt rất nhiều chiên và bò để đãi vua và những người đi với vua, rồi thuyết phục vua cùng đi lên đánh Ra-mốt Ga-la-át.
vi.R: Vài năm sau, Giô-sa-phát đi thăm A-háp tại thành Sa-ma-ri. A-háp giết rất nhiều chiên và bò để mở tiệc đãi Giô-sa-phát và những người đi với vua. Rồi A-háp thuyết phục Giô-sa-phát cùng mình tấn công thành Ra-mốt Ga-la-át.

ko.L: 그리고 몇 해가 끝날 무렵에 그가 사마리아로 아합에게 내려갔다. 그리고 아합이 그와 그와 함께한 백성을 위하여 양과 소를 많이 잡고, 그를 꾀어 길르앗 라못으로 올라가게 했다.
ko.B: 몇 해 뒤에 그는 아합을 만나러 사마리아로 내려갔다. 아합은 그와 그와 함께 온 사람들을 위하여 양과 소를 많이 잡고, 길르앗 라못을 치러 올라가자고 그를 부추겼다.
ko.R: 몇 해 뒤에 여호사밧은 아합을 만나러 사마리아 성으로 갔다. 아합은 그와 그와 함께 온 사람들을 위하여 양과 소를 아주 많이 잡아 잔치를 베풀었다. 그리고 여호사밧에게 함께 길르앗 라못 성을 치러 가자고 부추겼다.

pt.L: E ao fim de [alguns] anos ele desceu a Acabe, a Samaria. E Acabe abateu para ele ovelhas e bois em abundância, e para o povo que [estava] com ele, e o atraiu a subir contra Ramote-Gileade.
pt.B: Alguns anos depois, ele desceu para visitar Acabe em Samaria. Acabe abateu ovelhas e bois em grande quantidade para ele e para as pessoas que estavam com ele, e insistiu para que ele subisse contra Ramote-Gileade.
pt.R: Alguns anos depois, Josafá foi visitar Acabe na cidade de Samaria. Acabe matou muitas ovelhas e bois para fazer uma festa para ele e para as pessoas que estavam com ele. E Acabe insistiu com Josafá para que o acompanhasse no ataque à cidade de Ramote-Gileade.

decisions.choice: the visit of 1 Kings 22:2, told with a feast and with Ahab's persuasion
decisions.reason: 1 Kings 22:2 says that "in the third year" Jehoshaphat went down to the king of Israel. Chronicles says "at the end of years", names Ahab and Samaria, and adds the feast Ahab gave and his urging Jehoshaphat to join the war. It leaves out 1 Kings 22:3, where the king of Israel tells his officials that Ramoth-gilead belongs to Israel and is still held by the king of Aram. In Chronicles the war is Ahab's plan, and Jehoshaphat is drawn into it.

decisions.choice: enticed: urged, drew him on, often toward harm
decisions.reason: The verb means to urge or lure someone, usually toward something wrong or harmful (Deuteronomy 13:7; 1 Chronicles 21:1). Ahab wins Jehoshaphat over with lavish hospitality. The same verb comes back in verse 31, where God draws the enemy chariots away from Jehoshaphat.

decisions.choice: slaughtered sheep and cattle: a great feast of welcome
decisions.reason: The verb can mean to sacrifice, but it is also used of killing animals for a feast (1 Kings 1:9, 19). Here it is a royal banquet for Jehoshaphat and all his company, a sign of honor that also served Ahab's purpose.

decisions.choice: Ramoth-gilead: an Israelite town east of the Jordan held by Aram
decisions.reason: Ramoth in Gilead lay east of the Jordan, in the territory of Gad. It was one of the cities of refuge (Deuteronomy 4:43; Joshua 20:8). According to 1 Kings 22:3 it belonged to Israel but was in the hands of the king of Aram.

decisions.choice: went down: traveled from Jerusalem north to Samaria
decisions.reason: Jerusalem stands high in the hill country, so a journey away from it is spoken of as going down, as in 1 Kings 22:2. Samaria was Ahab's capital.

decisions.choice: went down to visit; to hold a feast; to join him in attacking
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable add "to visit", as 1 Kings 22:2 does, to make clear this was a royal visit. Readable also says what the slaughter was for (m3), names the two kings where "he" and "him" would be unclear, and adds "the city of" to the place names.

decisions.choice: "lo indujo" (L); "lo persuadió" (B); "convenció" (R)
decisions.reason: The verb means to urge or lure, usually toward harm (meaning decision); Literal uses "inducir", the verb the Spanish of 1 Kings 22:20 uses for the luring of Ahab, which verse 19 takes up.

decisions.choice: "dụ" (L); "thuyết phục" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The verb means to draw someone on, often toward harm (m2); Literal keeps "dụ", the same verb as for the spirit in verses 19-21, where Kings has "dụ dỗ".

decisions.choice: o atraiu (L), and "os atraiu" in verse 31
decisions.reason: The verb means to lure someone, often toward harm (m2), and comes back in verse 31 of God drawing the chariots away; Literal says "atrair" in both places so the reader can see the turn. Balanced and Readable say "insistiu", as the English says "urged".

source.text: וַיֹּ֜אמֶר אַחְאָ֣ב מֶֽלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל אֶל־יְהֽוֹשָׁפָט֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֔ה הֲתֵלֵ֥ךְ עִמִּ֖י רָמֹ֣ת גִּלְעָ֑ד וַיֹּ֣אמֶר ל֗וֹ כָּמ֤וֹנִי כָמ֨וֹךָ֙ וּכְעַמְּךָ֣ עַמִּ֔י וְעִמְּךָ֖ בַּמִּלְחָמָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And said Ahab king of Israel to Jehoshaphat king of Judah, will you go with me [to] Ramoth-gilead? And he said to him, as me as you, and as your people my people, and with you in the battle.

en.L: And Ahab king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat king of Judah, "Will you go with me [to] Ramoth-gilead?" And he said to him, "As I [am], so [are] you; and as your people, so my people; and [we will be] with you in the battle."
en.B: Ahab king of Israel asked Jehoshaphat king of Judah, "Will you come with me to Ramoth-gilead?" He replied, "I am as you are, and my troops are as your troops. We will be with you in the battle."
en.R: Ahab king of Israel asked Jehoshaphat king of Judah, "Will you join me in attacking Ramoth-gilead?" Jehoshaphat told him, "I am with you all the way. My army is yours to command. We will go into battle with you."

es.L: Y dijo Acab rey de Israel a Josafat rey de Judá: «¿Irás conmigo [a] Ramot de Galaad?». Y él le dijo: «Como yo, así tú; y como tu pueblo, así mi pueblo; y [estaremos] contigo en la batalla».
es.B: Acab rey de Israel le preguntó a Josafat rey de Judá: «¿Vendrás conmigo a Ramot de Galaad?». Él le respondió: «Yo soy como tú, y mis tropas como tus tropas. Estaremos contigo en la batalla».
es.R: Acab rey de Israel le preguntó a Josafat rey de Judá: «¿Me acompañarás a atacar Ramot de Galaad?». Josafat le dijo: «Estoy contigo en todo. Mi ejército está a tus órdenes. Iremos contigo a la batalla».

fr.L: Et Achab, roi d’Israël, dit à Josaphat, roi de Juda : « Viendras-tu avec moi [à] Ramoth de Galaad ? » Et il lui dit : « Moi comme toi, et ton peuple comme mon peuple ; et [nous serons] avec toi dans la bataille. »
fr.B: Achab, roi d’Israël, demanda à Josaphat, roi de Juda : « Viendras-tu avec moi à Ramoth de Galaad ? » Il répondit : « Je suis comme toi, mes troupes sont comme tes troupes. Nous serons avec toi dans la bataille. »
fr.R: Achab, roi d’Israël, a demandé à Josaphat, roi de Juda : « Veux-tu venir avec moi attaquer Ramoth de Galaad ? » Josaphat lui a répondu : « Je suis entièrement avec toi. Mon armée est à tes ordres. Nous irons au combat avec toi. »

sw.L: Ahabu mfalme wa Israeli akamwambia Yehoshafati mfalme wa Yuda, "Je, utakwenda pamoja nami [huko] Ramoth-gileadi?" Akamwambia, "Kama mimi [nilivyo], ndivyo ulivyo wewe; kama watu wako, ndivyo watu wangu; na [tutakuwa] pamoja nawe vitani."
sw.B: Ahabu mfalme wa Israeli akamwuliza Yehoshafati mfalme wa Yuda, "Je, utakwenda pamoja nami Ramoth-gileadi?" Akajibu, "Mimi ni kama wewe, na askari wangu ni kama askari wako. Tutakuwa pamoja nawe vitani."
sw.R: Ahabu mfalme wa Israeli akamwuliza Yehoshafati mfalme wa Yuda, "Je, utaungana nami kuushambulia Ramoth-gileadi?" Yehoshafati akamwambia, "Niko pamoja nawe kabisa. Jeshi langu liko chini ya amri yako. Tutakwenda vitani pamoja nawe."

vi.L: A-háp vua Y-sơ-ra-ên nói với Giô-sa-phát vua Giu-đa: "Vua có đi với tôi [đến] Ra-mốt Ga-la-át không?" Ông nói với vua: "Tôi cũng như vua, dân tôi như dân vua; và [chúng tôi sẽ] cùng vua ra trận."
vi.B: A-háp vua Y-sơ-ra-ên hỏi Giô-sa-phát vua Giu-đa: "Vua có đi với tôi đến Ra-mốt Ga-la-át không?" Giô-sa-phát đáp: "Tôi cũng như vua, quân tôi như quân vua. Chúng tôi sẽ cùng vua ra trận."
vi.R: A-háp vua Y-sơ-ra-ên hỏi Giô-sa-phát vua Giu-đa: "Vua có cùng tôi tấn công Ra-mốt Ga-la-át không?" Giô-sa-phát trả lời: "Tôi sẵn sàng đi với vua. Quân đội của tôi nghe theo lệnh vua. Chúng tôi sẽ cùng vua ra trận."

ko.L: 그리고 이스라엘 왕 아합이 유다 왕 여호사밧에게 말했다. "나와 함께 길르앗 라못으로 가겠소?" 그러자 그가 그에게 말했다. "나는 당신과 같고, 내 백성은 당신의 백성과 같으니, 전쟁에서 [우리가] 당신과 함께하겠소."
ko.B: 이스라엘 왕 아합이 유다 왕 여호사밧에게 물었다. "나와 함께 길르앗 라못으로 가겠소?" 여호사밧이 대답했다. "나와 당신은 하나요. 내 군대도 당신의 군대와 같소. 우리가 이 전쟁에서 당신과 함께하겠소."
ko.R: 이스라엘 왕 아합이 유다 왕 여호사밧에게 물었다. "나와 함께 길르앗 라못을 치러 가겠소?" 여호사밧이 대답했다. "나는 끝까지 당신과 함께하겠소. 내 군대도 당신이 마음대로 쓰시오. 우리가 당신과 함께 싸우러 나가겠소."

pt.L: E Acabe, rei de Israel, disse a Josafá, rei de Judá: "Você irá comigo [a] Ramote-Gileade?" E ele lhe disse: "Como eu, [assim é] você; e como o seu povo, [assim é] o meu povo; e [estaremos] com você na batalha."
pt.B: Acabe, rei de Israel, perguntou a Josafá, rei de Judá: "Você irá comigo a Ramote-Gileade?" Ele respondeu: "Eu sou como você, e as minhas tropas são como as suas tropas. Estaremos com você na batalha."
pt.R: Acabe, rei de Israel, perguntou a Josafá, rei de Judá: "Você vai comigo atacar Ramote-Gileade?" Josafá respondeu: "Estou com você para o que der e vier. O meu exército está às suas ordens. Iremos à batalha com você."

decisions.choice: the request and answer of 1 Kings 22:4, with three differences
decisions.reason: Chronicles names Ahab and gives both kings their titles, where 1 Kings 22:4 has only "he said to Jehoshaphat". The question lacks "to battle". Jehoshaphat's answer turns one pair around ("as your people, so my people"), leaves out the horses, and ends with a promise of its own: "and with you in the battle".

decisions.choice: as I am, so are you ...: I am fully with you; all I have is at your disposal
decisions.reason: Jehoshaphat answers with a set saying of alliance. He puts himself and his army on the same footing as Ahab's, and then says it plainly: he will be with Ahab in the battle, fighting alongside him as one force.

decisions.choice: your people ... my people: your army ... my army
decisions.reason: Here "people" means the fighting men a king leads into battle, as often in these books.

decisions.choice: troops / army
decisions.reason: The army sense of "people" (m3): Literal keeps "people", Balanced says "troops" and Readable "army", as in these books generally.

decisions.choice: [we will be] with you / We will be with you
decisions.reason: The last clause has no verb. Literal brackets the words English needs; Balanced and Readable supply them. Readable also says what the saying means (m2), as in 1 Kings 22:4, and names Jehoshaphat where the Hebrew has "he".

decisions.choice: "pueblo" (L); "tropas" (B); "ejército" (R)
decisions.reason: As the Samuel note sets: "the people" meaning the army is "pueblo" at Literal and "tropas", "ejército" at Balanced and Readable, as in the Spanish of 1 Kings 22:4.

decisions.choice: The two kings speak to each other in 하오체; the wording of 1 Kings 22 at each level
decisions.reason: Chapter 18 retells 1 Kings 22:1-35 almost word for word; the Korean repeats Kings and changes only what the Hebrew changes.

decisions.choice: as 1 Kings 22:4, with Chronicles' changes; você (the two kings)
decisions.reason: The request and answer keep the Portuguese of 1 Kings 22:4 ("você" between the two kings, Readable's "para o que der e vier"), changing what Chronicles changes (m1): both kings named with their titles, no "à batalha" in the question, "o seu povo ... o meu povo" turned round, no horses, and the last clause "[estaremos] com você na batalha".

es.B: Pero Josafat le dijo al rey de Israel: «Primero, por favor, consulta la palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}».

vi.B: Nhưng Giô-sa-phát nói với vua Y-sơ-ra-ên: "Trước hết, xin vua cầu hỏi lời của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}."

pt.B: Mas Josafá disse ao rei de Israel: "Primeiro, por favor, consulte a palavra {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}."
pt.R: Mas Josafá também disse ao rei de Israel: "Primeiro, por favor, pergunte {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}} o que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} diz."

decisions.choice: seek the word of Yahweh: ask a prophet for Yahweh's answer before going to war
decisions.reason: Kings asked God before a battle whether to go and whether they would win, usually through a prophet or a priest (1 Samuel 23:2-4; 30:7-8). Jehoshaphat will not set out until this has been done.

decisions.choice: as the day: first, now, before anything else
decisions.reason: The phrase can mean "today" or "at once". Here it asks that the inquiry be made now, before they march.

decisions.choice: wording of 1 Kings 22:5 kept

decisions.choice: the wording of 1 Kings 22:5

records.literal_gloss: And gathered [the] king of Israel the prophets, four hundred man, and said to them, shall we go against Ramoth-gilead for battle, or shall I refrain? And they said, go up, and will give the God into [the] hand of the king.

en.L: And the king of Israel gathered the prophets, four hundred men, and said to them, "Shall we go against Ramoth-gilead for battle, or shall I refrain?" And they said, "Go up, and God will give [it] into the hand of the king."
en.B: So the king of Israel gathered the prophets, four hundred men, and asked them, "Shall we go to war against Ramoth-gilead, or shall I hold back?" "Go up," they said, "for God will give it into the king's hand."
en.R: So the king of Israel called together four hundred prophets. He asked them, "Should we go to war against Ramoth-gilead, or not?" They answered, "Go! God will help you capture it, Your Majesty."

es.L: Y el rey de Israel reunió a los profetas, cuatrocientos hombres, y les dijo: «¿Iremos contra Ramot de Galaad a la batalla, o desistiré?». Y ellos dijeron: «Sube, porque Dios [la] entregará en mano del rey».
es.B: Así que el rey de Israel reunió a los profetas, cuatrocientos hombres, y les preguntó: «¿Debemos ir a la guerra contra Ramot de Galaad, o debo desistir?». «Sube», le dijeron, «porque Dios la entregará en manos del rey».
es.R: Así que el rey de Israel reunió a cuatrocientos profetas. Les preguntó: «¿Debemos ir a la guerra contra Ramot de Galaad, o no?». Ellos respondieron: «¡Ve! Dios te ayudará a conquistarla, oh rey».

fr.L: Et le roi d’Israël rassembla les prophètes, quatre cents hommes, et leur dit : « Irons-nous contre Ramoth de Galaad pour combattre, ou m’en abstiendrai-je ? » Et ils dirent : « Monte, et Dieu [la] livrera entre les mains du roi. »
fr.B: Le roi d’Israël rassembla donc les prophètes, quatre cents hommes, et leur demanda : « Devons-nous partir en guerre contre Ramoth de Galaad, ou dois-je y renoncer ? » « Monte, dirent-ils, car Dieu la livrera entre les mains du roi. »
fr.R: Le roi d’Israël a donc réuni quatre cents prophètes. Il leur a demandé : « Est-ce que nous devons partir en guerre contre Ramoth de Galaad, ou pas ? » Ils ont répondu : « Vas-y ! Dieu t’aidera à la prendre, ô roi. »

sw.B: Basi mfalme wa Israeli akawakusanya manabii, watu 400, akawauliza, "Je, twende vitani kupigana na Ramoth-gileadi, au nijizuie?" Wakajibu, "Panda, kwa maana Mungu ataitia mkononi mwa mfalme."
sw.R: Basi mfalme wa Israeli akawaita pamoja manabii 400. Akawauliza, "Je, twende vitani kupigana na Ramoth-gileadi, au tusiende?" Wakajibu, "Nenda! Mungu atakusaidia kuuteka, Mtukufu mfalme."

vi.L: Vua Y-sơ-ra-ên tập họp các nhà tiên tri, bốn trăm người, và hỏi họ: "Chúng ta có nên đi đánh Ra-mốt Ga-la-át không, hay ta nên thôi?" Họ đáp: "Xin vua đi lên, và Đức Chúa Trời sẽ phó [thành ấy] vào tay vua."
vi.B: Vậy vua Y-sơ-ra-ên tập họp các nhà tiên tri, bốn trăm người, và hỏi: "Chúng ta có nên đi đánh Ra-mốt Ga-la-át không, hay ta nên dừng lại?" Họ đáp: "Xin vua cứ đi lên, vì Đức Chúa Trời sẽ phó thành ấy vào tay vua."
vi.R: Vậy vua Y-sơ-ra-ên gọi bốn trăm nhà tiên tri đến. Vua hỏi họ: "Chúng ta có nên đi đánh Ra-mốt Ga-la-át hay không?" Họ trả lời: "Thưa đức vua, xin cứ đi! Đức Chúa Trời sẽ giúp đức vua chiếm được thành ấy."

ko.L: 그리고 이스라엘 왕이 예언자들 400명을 모으고 그들에게 말했다. "우리가 길르앗 라못을 치러 싸우러 가야 하겠느냐, 내가 그만두어야 하겠느냐?" 그러자 그들이 말했다. "올라가십시오. 하나님께서 [그것을] 임금님의 손에 넘겨주실 것입니다."
ko.B: 그래서 이스라엘 왕은 예언자 400명을 모아 놓고 그들에게 물었다. "우리가 길르앗 라못을 치러 가야 하겠느냐, 내가 그만두어야 하겠느냐?" 그들이 대답했다. "올라가십시오. 하나님께서 그 성을 임금님의 손에 넘겨주실 것입니다."
ko.R: 그래서 이스라엘 왕은 예언자 400명을 불러 모았다. 그가 그들에게 물었다. "우리가 길르앗 라못을 치러 가야 하겠느냐, 말아야 하겠느냐?" 그들이 대답했다. "가십시오! 하나님께서 임금님이 그 성을 차지하도록 도와주실 것입니다."

pt.L: E o rei de Israel reuniu os profetas, quatrocentos homens, e lhes disse: "Iremos contra Ramote-Gileade para a batalha, ou desistirei?" E eles disseram: "Suba, e Deus [a] entregará na mão do rei."
pt.B: Então o rei de Israel reuniu os profetas, quatrocentos homens, e lhes perguntou: "Devemos ir à guerra contra Ramote-Gileade, ou devo desistir?" "Suba", disseram eles, "porque Deus a entregará nas mãos do rei."
pt.R: Então o rei de Israel reuniu quatrocentos profetas. Ele lhes perguntou: "Devemos ir à guerra contra Ramote-Gileade, ou não?" Eles responderam: "Vá! Deus vai lhe dar a vitória sobre a cidade, Majestade."

decisions.choice: "God" where 1 Kings 22:6 has "the Lord"
decisions.reason: In 1 Kings 22:6 the prophets answer with the title "the Lord" (Adonai). Chronicles has "God" (with the article, "the God"), a word it often uses where Samuel and Kings have the divine name or a title. The prophets use the name Yahweh in verses 10-11, as in Kings. Chronicles also says "four hundred men" where Kings has "about four hundred", and the king asks "shall we go" where Kings has "shall I go".

decisions.choice: the prophets: a large group of court prophets
decisions.reason: These four hundred are prophets attached to Ahab's court. They speak in the name of Yahweh (verses 10-11, 23), but Jehoshaphat is not satisfied with them (verse 6).

decisions.choice: will give into the hand of the king: an answer that does not name what is given
decisions.reason: The Hebrew has no object: "will give into the hand of the king". The natural sense is that the city will be given to Ahab. The answer is also loose enough to be fulfilled in another way, since it does not say which king or what will be given; verses 18-22 show the promise was a deception.

decisions.choice: give into the hand of: give victory over, let capture
decisions.reason: To give something into someone's hand is to put it in their power.

decisions.choice: shall we go ... or shall I refrain?: "we" and "I" in one question
decisions.reason: The king first speaks for both kings ("we"), then of himself ("I"). The question is still the one decision: whether the campaign goes ahead.

decisions.choice: it
decisions.reason: Balanced supplies "it", the city, as the natural object (m3). Literal brackets the word.

decisions.choice: help you capture it, Your Majesty
decisions.reason: Readable says what "give into the hand" means (m4) and turns "the king" into a direct address, since the prophets are speaking to him.

decisions.choice: "Dios"
decisions.reason: Chronicles has "God" where 1 Kings 22:6 has the title "the Lord" (meaning decision).

decisions.choice: "oh rey" (R)
decisions.reason: Where the English Readable says "Your Majesty", Spanish says "oh rey", as the Samuel note sets, since "Majestad" would need "usted".

decisions.choice: Mungu
decisions.reason: Chronicles has "God" where 1 Kings 22:6 has "the Lord", so the Swahili Kings "Bwana" becomes "Mungu" here.

decisions.choice: "Đức Chúa Trời" where 1 Kings 22:6 has "Chúa"
decisions.reason: Chronicles has "God" (m1); "chúng ta ... ta" keeps the "we" and "I" of the question (m5).

decisions.choice: "하나님께서" where 1 Kings 22:6 has "주님께서"
decisions.reason: Chronicles' Hebrew reads "God" here; Korean changes that word only.

decisions.choice: Deus (where 1 Kings 22:6 has "o Senhor"); quatrocentos homens; Iremos ... desistirei (L), Devemos ... devo (B)
decisions.reason: As 1 Kings 22:6 in Portuguese, with Chronicles' changes: the prophets say "Deus" where Kings has the title "o Senhor" (m1); there is no "cerca de", as Chronicles has no "about"; and the king says "we" and then "I" (m5), which Literal and Balanced keep.

records.literal_gloss: And said Jehoshaphat, is there not here a prophet of Yahweh still, and we may inquire of him?

en.L: And Jehoshaphat said, "Is there not here still a prophet of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, that we may inquire of him?"
en.B: But Jehoshaphat said, "Is there no other prophet of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} here whom we can ask?"
en.R: But Jehoshaphat asked, "Is there not another prophet of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} here? We should ask him too."

es.R: Pero Josafat preguntó: «¿No hay aquí otro profeta {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}? Deberíamos consultarle a él también».

fr.B: Mais Josaphat dit : « N’y a-t-il pas ici un autre prophète {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, que nous pourrions consulter ? »
fr.R: Mais Josaphat a demandé : « N’y a-t-il pas ici un autre prophète {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ? Nous devrions le consulter lui aussi. »

sw.L: Yehoshafati akasema, "Je, hapa hakuna tena nabii wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ili tumwulize yeye?"
sw.B: Lakini Yehoshafati akasema, "Je, hakuna nabii mwingine wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} hapa ambaye tunaweza kumwuliza?"
sw.R: Lakini Yehoshafati akauliza, "Je, hakuna nabii mwingine wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} hapa? Tunapaswa kumwuliza yeye pia."

vi.L: Giô-sa-phát nói: "Ở đây không còn nhà tiên tri nào của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} để chúng ta cầu hỏi sao?"
vi.B: Nhưng Giô-sa-phát hỏi: "Ở đây không còn nhà tiên tri nào khác của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} để chúng ta cầu hỏi sao?"
vi.R: Nhưng Giô-sa-phát hỏi: "Ở đây không có nhà tiên tri nào khác của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sao? Chúng ta cũng nên hỏi người ấy nữa."

ko.L: 그러자 여호사밧이 말했다. "여기에 우리가 물어볼 만한 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 예언자가 아직 있지 않소?"
ko.B: 그러나 여호사밧이 말했다. "여기에 우리가 물어볼 수 있는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 예언자가 또 없소?"
ko.R: 그러나 여호사밧이 물었다. "여기에 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 예언자가 또 없소? 그에게도 물어봐야겠소."

pt.L: E Josafá disse: "Não [há] aqui ainda um profeta {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, para que o consultemos?"
pt.B: Mas Josafá perguntou: "Não há aqui nenhum outro profeta {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} a quem possamos consultar?"
pt.R: Mas Josafá perguntou: "Não há aqui outro profeta {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}? Devíamos perguntar a ele também."

decisions.choice: the same words as 1 Kings 22:7
decisions.reason: This verse matches 1 Kings 22:7 except for a small difference in how one word is written, which does not change the sense. Its wording here is the same as there.

decisions.choice: is there not still here a prophet of Yahweh?: is there no other prophet besides these?
decisions.reason: "Still" means "besides" or "in addition". Jehoshaphat does not deny that the four hundred are prophets, but he wants another voice. The question suggests that he does not trust their quick agreement.

decisions.choice: other / another
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable express "still" as "other" (m2).

source.text: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר מֶֽלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל׀אֶֽל־יְהוֹשָׁפָ֡ט ע֣וֹד אִישׁ־אֶחָ֡ד לִדְרוֹשׁ֩ אֶת־יְהוָ֨ה מֵֽאֹת֜וֹ וַאֲנִ֣י שְׂנֵאתִ֗יהוּ כִּֽי־אֵ֠ינֶנּוּ מִתְנַבֵּ֨א עָלַ֤י לְטוֹבָה֙ כִּ֣י כָל־יָמָ֣יו לְרָעָ֔ה ה֖וּא מִיכָ֣יְהוּ בֶן־יִמְלָ֑א וַיֹּ֨אמֶר֙ יְה֣וֹשָׁפָ֔ט אַל־יֹאמַ֥ר הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ כֵּֽן׃

records.literal_gloss: And said [the] king of Israel to Jehoshaphat, still [there is] one man to inquire of Yahweh from him, and I hate him, for he [is] not prophesying concerning me for good, but all his days for evil; he [is] Micaiah son of Imlah. And said Jehoshaphat, not let say the king so.

en.L: And the king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, "[There is] still one man by whom to inquire of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, but I hate him, for he does not prophesy concerning me for good, but all his days for evil: he [is] Micaiah son of Imlah." And Jehoshaphat said, "Let not the king say so."
en.B: The king of Israel answered Jehoshaphat, "There is still one man through whom we could inquire of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}: Micaiah son of Imlah. But I hate him, for his prophecies about me are never good, but always bad." Jehoshaphat said, "Let the king not speak like that."
en.R: The king of Israel answered Jehoshaphat, "There is one more man we could ask to find out what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} says. But I hate him. He never says anything good about me. He always predicts trouble for me. His name is Micaiah son of Imlah." Jehoshaphat said, "Your Majesty, you should not say that."

es.L: Y el rey de Israel dijo a Josafat: «Todavía [hay] un hombre por medio del cual consultar {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, pero yo lo aborrezco, porque no profetiza acerca de mí el bien, sino el mal todos sus días: Micaías hijo de Imla». Y Josafat dijo: «No diga eso el rey».
es.B: El rey de Israel le respondió a Josafat: «Todavía hay un hombre por medio del cual podríamos consultar {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}: Micaías hijo de Imla. Pero yo lo aborrezco, porque sus profecías sobre mí nunca son buenas, sino siempre malas». Josafat dijo: «No hable así el rey».
es.R: El rey de Israel le respondió a Josafat: «Hay un hombre más a quien podríamos preguntarle lo que dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}. Pero yo lo aborrezco. Nunca dice nada bueno de mí. Siempre me anuncia desgracias. Se llama Micaías hijo de Imla». Josafat dijo: «Oh rey, no deberías decir eso».

fr.L: Et le roi d’Israël dit à Josaphat : « [Il y a] encore un homme par qui consulter {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, mais moi je le hais, car il ne prophétise pas du bien sur moi, mais tous ses jours du mal : c’est Michée fils de Yimla. » Et Josaphat dit : « Que le roi ne parle pas ainsi. »
fr.B: Le roi d’Israël répondit à Josaphat : « Il reste un homme par qui nous pourrions consulter {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : Michée, fils de Yimla. Mais je le hais, car il ne prophétise jamais rien de bon pour moi, toujours du mal. » Josaphat dit : « Que le roi ne parle pas ainsi. »
fr.R: Le roi d’Israël a répondu à Josaphat : « Il y a encore un homme que nous pourrions consulter pour savoir ce que dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. Mais je le déteste. Il ne dit jamais rien de bon sur moi. Il ne m’annonce toujours que des malheurs. Il s’appelle Michée, fils de Yimla. » Josaphat a dit : « Ô roi, tu ne devrais pas dire cela. »

sw.L: Mfalme wa Israeli akamwambia Yehoshafati, "Bado [yupo] mtu mmoja ambaye kwa yeye tunaweza kumwuliza {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, lakini mimi namchukia, kwa maana hanitabirii mema, bali mabaya siku zake zote: yeye [ni] Mikaya mwana wa Imla." Yehoshafati akasema, "Mfalme asiseme hivyo."
sw.B: Mfalme wa Israeli akamjibu Yehoshafati, "Bado yupo mtu mmoja ambaye kupitia yeye tungeweza kumwuliza {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}: Mikaya mwana wa Imla. Lakini mimi namchukia, kwa sababu hanitabirii kamwe mema juu yangu, ila mabaya tu siku zote." Yehoshafati akasema, "Mfalme asiseme hivyo."
sw.R: Mfalme wa Israeli akamjibu Yehoshafati, "Yupo mtu mmoja zaidi ambaye tungeweza kumwuliza ili tujue {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anasema nini. Lakini mimi namchukia. Kamwe hasemi jambo jema juu yangu. Daima hunitabiria taabu. Jina lake ni Mikaya mwana wa Imla." Yehoshafati akasema, "Mtukufu mfalme, usiseme hivyo."

vi.L: Vua Y-sơ-ra-ên nói với Giô-sa-phát: "Còn một người nữa để nhờ người ấy mà cầu hỏi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, nhưng tôi ghét hắn, vì hắn không nói tiên tri điều lành về tôi, mà suốt đời hắn chỉ điều dữ: đó là Mi-chê con trai Giêm-la." Giô-sa-phát nói: "Xin vua đừng nói như vậy."
vi.B: Vua Y-sơ-ra-ên trả lời Giô-sa-phát: "Còn một người nữa có thể nhờ cầu hỏi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, đó là Mi-chê con trai Giêm-la. Nhưng tôi ghét hắn, vì hắn chẳng bao giờ nói tiên tri điều lành về tôi, lúc nào cũng toàn điều dữ." Giô-sa-phát nói: "Xin vua đừng nói như vậy."
vi.R: Vua Y-sơ-ra-ên trả lời Giô-sa-phát: "Còn một người nữa chúng ta có thể hỏi để biết {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán thế nào. Nhưng tôi ghét hắn. Hắn chẳng bao giờ nói điều gì tốt về tôi. Lúc nào hắn cũng báo điều xấu. Tên hắn là Mi-chê con trai Giêm-la." Giô-sa-phát nói: "Thưa vua, vua không nên nói như vậy."

ko.L: 그러자 이스라엘 왕이 여호사밧에게 말했다. "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 여쭈어 볼 사람이 아직 한 사람 있소. 그러나 나는 그를 미워하오. 그는 나에 대해 좋은 것은 예언하지 않고 평생 나쁜 것만 예언하기 때문이오. 그는 이믈라의 아들 미가야요." 그러자 여호사밧이 말했다. "왕께서는 그렇게 말씀하지 마시오."
ko.B: 이스라엘 왕이 여호사밧에게 대답했다. "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 여쭈어 볼 수 있는 사람이 아직 하나 있소. 이믈라의 아들 미가야요. 그러나 나는 그를 미워하오. 그는 나에 대해 좋은 것은 하나도 예언하지 않고 언제나 나쁜 것만 예언하오." 여호사밧이 말했다. "왕께서는 그런 말씀을 하지 마시오."
ko.R: 이스라엘 왕이 여호사밧에게 대답했다. "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 무엇이라고 하시는지 물어볼 수 있는 사람이 하나 더 있소. 그러나 나는 그를 미워하오. 그는 나에 대해 좋은 말은 한 번도 하지 않소. 언제나 나에게 나쁜 일이 생긴다고만 하오. 그의 이름은 이믈라의 아들 미가야요." 여호사밧이 말했다. "왕께서는 그런 말씀을 하시면 안 되오."

pt.L: E o rei de Israel disse a Josafá: "[Há] ainda um homem por meio de quem [se pode] consultar {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, mas eu o odeio, porque ele não profetiza a meu respeito o bem, mas todos os seus dias para o mal: ele [é] Micaías, filho de Inlá." E Josafá disse: "Não diga o rei assim."
pt.B: O rei de Israel respondeu a Josafá: "Ainda há um homem por meio de quem poderíamos consultar {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}: Micaías, filho de Inlá. Mas eu o odeio, porque as profecias dele a meu respeito nunca são boas, são sempre más." Josafá disse: "Que o rei não fale assim."
pt.R: O rei de Israel respondeu a Josafá: "Ainda há um homem a quem poderíamos perguntar o que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} diz. Mas eu o odeio. Ele nunca diz nada de bom a meu respeito. Sempre anuncia desgraças para mim. O nome dele é Micaías, filho de Inlá." Josafá disse: "Majestade, o senhor não deveria dizer isso."

decisions.choice: "all his days for evil" where 1 Kings 22:8 has "but evil"
decisions.reason: Chronicles sharpens Ahab's complaint: Micaiah prophesies not for good "but all his days for evil", that is, always harm. It also adds "he is" before Micaiah's name. Otherwise the verse is the same as 1 Kings 22:8.

decisions.choice: good ... evil: good fortune ... disaster
decisions.reason: "Good" and "evil" here are what the prophecies promise: success or trouble. Ahab complains that Micaiah only ever announces harm for him.

decisions.choice: Micaiah son of Imlah: a prophet of Yahweh known only from this story
decisions.reason: His name means "Who is like Yahweh?" He is not the Micah of the book of Micah, who lived over a century later. Elijah is not mentioned in this chapter.

decisions.choice: let not the king say so: a polite rebuke
decisions.reason: Jehoshaphat speaks of Ahab in the third person, as was polite toward a king. He objects to Ahab's hatred for a prophet of Yahweh, or to the idea that a prophet speaks only to please.

decisions.choice: bad / trouble; always
decisions.reason: Balanced says "bad" and Readable "trouble" for the sense of "evil" here (m2); Literal keeps "evil". Balanced and Readable say "always" for "all his days" (m1).

decisions.choice: Your Majesty, you should not say that
decisions.reason: Readable turns the polite third person (m4) into a direct address.

decisions.choice: "No diga eso el rey" (L, B); "Oh rey, no deberías decir eso" (R)
decisions.reason: As the Spanish of 1 Kings 22:8: Jehoshaphat speaks of the king in the third person, a courtesy Spanish keeps with the subjunctive; Readable turns to "tú" with "oh rey".

decisions.choice: "Ô roi, tu ne devrais pas dire cela"
decisions.reason: Where the English Readable says "Your Majesty", French says "ô roi", as the Samuel note sets out and French Kings does here; "Majesté" would need "vous".

decisions.choice: Mtukufu mfalme, usiseme hivyo
decisions.reason: As in the Swahili Kings, the English Readable "Your Majesty" is "Mtukufu mfalme", and the polite third person becomes a direct address.

decisions.choice: as 1 Kings 22:8, with "todos os seus dias para o mal" (L), "sempre" (B, R); ele [é] Micaías (L)
decisions.reason: Chronicles sharpens the complaint, "but all his days for evil", and adds "he is" before the name (m1); Portuguese makes those changes to the wording of 1 Kings 22:8 and keeps the rest, "Micaías, filho de Inlá" (m3) and Jehoshaphat's courtly "o rei" (m4) included.

source.text: וַיִּקְרָא֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֶל־סָרִ֖יס אֶחָ֑ד וַיֹּ֕אמֶר מַהֵ֖ר מִיכָ֥יְהוּ בֶן־יִמְלָֽא׃

records.literal_gloss: And called [the] king of Israel to one official, and said, hurry Micaiah son of Imlah.

en.L: And the king of Israel called to one official and said, "Hurry [to bring] Micaiah son of Imlah."
en.B: So the king of Israel called one of his court officials and said, "Bring Micaiah son of Imlah at once."
en.R: So the king of Israel sent for one of his officials. He told him, "Go and get Micaiah son of Imlah. Hurry!"

es.L: Y el rey de Israel llamó a un funcionario y dijo: «[Trae] pronto a Micaías hijo de Imla».
es.B: Así que el rey de Israel llamó a uno de los funcionarios de la corte y le dijo: «Trae enseguida a Micaías hijo de Imla».
es.R: Así que el rey de Israel mandó llamar a uno de sus funcionarios. Le dijo: «Ve a buscar a Micaías hijo de Imla. ¡Date prisa!».

fr.L: Et le roi d’Israël appela un haut fonctionnaire et dit : « Vite, [fais venir] Michée fils de Yimla. »
fr.B: Le roi d’Israël appela donc un haut fonctionnaire de la cour et lui dit : « Fais venir tout de suite Michée, fils de Yimla. »
fr.R: Alors le roi d’Israël a fait venir un de ses fonctionnaires. Il lui a dit : « Va chercher Michée, fils de Yimla. Vite ! »

sw.L: Mfalme wa Israeli akamwita afisa mmoja, akasema, "Haraka [mlete] Mikaya mwana wa Imla."
sw.B: Basi mfalme wa Israeli akamwita mmoja wa maafisa wa ikulu, akasema, "Mlete Mikaya mwana wa Imla mara moja."
sw.R: Basi mfalme wa Israeli akamwita mmoja wa maafisa wake. Akamwambia, "Nenda ukamlete Mikaya mwana wa Imla. Fanya haraka!"

vi.L: Vua Y-sơ-ra-ên gọi một viên quan và nói: "Hãy mau [đem] Mi-chê con trai Giêm-la [đến]."
vi.B: Vậy vua Y-sơ-ra-ên gọi một viên quan trong triều và bảo: "Hãy đem Mi-chê con trai Giêm-la đến đây ngay."
vi.R: Vậy vua Y-sơ-ra-ên cho gọi một viên quan. Vua bảo: "Hãy đi gọi Mi-chê con trai Giêm-la đến đây. Mau lên!"

ko.L: 그리고 이스라엘 왕이 한 내시를 불러 말했다. "이믈라의 아들 미가야를 속히 [데려오너라]."
ko.B: 그래서 이스라엘 왕은 관리 한 사람을 불러 말했다. "이믈라의 아들 미가야를 당장 데려오너라."
ko.R: 그래서 이스라엘 왕은 관리 한 사람을 불러 말했다. "가서 이믈라의 아들 미가야를 데려오너라. 서둘러라!"

pt.L: E o rei de Israel chamou um oficial e disse: "Depressa, [traga] Micaías, filho de Inlá."
pt.B: Então o rei de Israel chamou um dos seus oficiais da corte e disse: "Traga imediatamente Micaías, filho de Inlá."
pt.R: Então o rei de Israel mandou chamar um dos seus oficiais. Ele lhe disse: "Vá buscar Micaías, filho de Inlá. Depressa!"

decisions.choice: the same order as 1 Kings 22:9
decisions.reason: The verse matches 1 Kings 22:9. The command "hurry" has a slightly different form there; the sense is the same, and so is the wording here.

decisions.choice: official: a court officer
decisions.reason: The word can mean a eunuch, but it is also the ordinary word for a high officer at a royal court, which is the sense here; nothing in the story turns on whether he was a eunuch.

decisions.choice: hurry Micaiah: bring Micaiah quickly
decisions.reason: The verb "hurry" takes Micaiah as its object: "make Micaiah come quickly".

decisions.choice: official
decisions.reason: Every level says "official" (m2). Literal may say "eunuch" where that sense matters; here it does not.

decisions.choice: "un funcionario"
decisions.reason: As the Spanish of 1 Kings 22:9: the *saris* is a court officer here, and the English Literal says "official" too.

decisions.choice: "내시" (L), "관리" (B, R) for *saris*
decisions.reason: The terms note's rendering, as 1 Kings 22:9.

decisions.choice: Depressa, [traga] Micaías (L)
decisions.reason: The verse is that of 1 Kings 22:9 (m1) and keeps its Portuguese, except that Literal's bracketed verb is singular, "[traga]", since the king speaks to one official (m2).

source.text: וּמֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֡ל וִֽיהוֹשָׁפָ֣ט מֶֽלֶךְ־יְהוּדָ֡ה יוֹשְׁבִים֩ אִ֨ישׁ עַל־כִּסְא֜וֹ מְלֻבָּשִׁ֤ים בְּגָדִים֙ וְיֹשְׁבִ֣ים בְּגֹ֔רֶן פֶּ֖תַח שַׁ֣עַר שֹׁמְר֑וֹן וְכָל־הַ֨נְּבִיאִ֔ים מִֽתְנַבְּאִ֖ים לִפְנֵיהֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And [the] king of Israel and Jehoshaphat king of Judah [were] sitting each on his throne, clothed [in] garments, and [they were] sitting at [the] threshing floor [at the] entrance of [the] gate of Samaria; and all the prophets [were] prophesying before them.

en.L: And the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat king of Judah [were] sitting each on his throne, clothed in robes, and [they were] sitting at the threshing floor at the entrance of the gate of Samaria; and all the prophets [were] prophesying before them.
en.B: Now the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat king of Judah were sitting on their thrones, dressed in their royal robes. They were sitting at the threshing floor at the entrance to the gate of Samaria, and all the prophets were prophesying in front of them.
en.R: The king of Israel and Jehoshaphat king of Judah sat on their thrones in their royal robes. They were at the threshing floor by the entrance to the city gate of Samaria. All the prophets were there in front of them, prophesying.

es.L: Y el rey de Israel y Josafat rey de Judá [estaban] sentados cada uno en su trono, vestidos con [sus] ropas, y [estaban] sentados en la era a la entrada de la puerta de Samaria; y todos los profetas profetizaban delante de ellos.
es.B: El rey de Israel y Josafat rey de Judá estaban sentados en sus tronos, vestidos con sus ropas reales. Estaban sentados en la era a la entrada de la puerta de Samaria, y todos los profetas profetizaban delante de ellos.
es.R: El rey de Israel y Josafat rey de Judá estaban sentados en sus tronos con sus ropas reales. Estaban en la era, junto a la entrada de la puerta de la ciudad de Samaria. Todos los profetas estaban allí delante de ellos, profetizando.

fr.L: Et le roi d’Israël et Josaphat, roi de Juda, [étaient] assis chacun sur son trône, revêtus de leurs habits, et [ils étaient] assis sur l’aire à l’entrée de la porte de Samarie ; et tous les prophètes prophétisaient devant eux.
fr.B: Le roi d’Israël et Josaphat, roi de Juda, étaient assis chacun sur son trône, vêtus de leurs habits royaux. Ils siégeaient sur l’aire à l’entrée de la porte de Samarie, et tous les prophètes prophétisaient devant eux.
fr.R: Le roi d’Israël et Josaphat, roi de Juda, étaient assis sur leurs trônes, dans leurs habits royaux. Ils étaient sur l’aire, près de l’entrée de la porte de Samarie. Tous les prophètes étaient là devant eux, en train de prophétiser.

sw.L: Mfalme wa Israeli na Yehoshafati mfalme wa Yuda [walikuwa] wameketi kila mmoja juu ya kiti chake cha enzi, wamevaa mavazi, [nao walikuwa] wameketi kwenye uwanja wa kupuria nafaka mlangoni pa lango la Samaria; na manabii wote [walikuwa] wakitabiri mbele yao.
sw.B: Wakati huo mfalme wa Israeli na Yehoshafati mfalme wa Yuda walikuwa wameketi juu ya viti vyao vya enzi, wamevaa mavazi yao ya kifalme. Walikuwa wameketi kwenye uwanja wa kupuria nafaka karibu na lango la Samaria, na manabii wote walikuwa wakitabiri mbele yao.
sw.R: Mfalme wa Israeli na Yehoshafati mfalme wa Yuda walikuwa wameketi juu ya viti vyao vya enzi, wamevaa mavazi yao ya kifalme. Walikuwa kwenye uwanja wa kupuria nafaka karibu na lango la mji wa Samaria. Manabii wote walikuwa pale mbele yao wakitabiri.

vi.L: Vua Y-sơ-ra-ên và Giô-sa-phát vua Giu-đa mỗi người ngồi trên ngai mình, mặc triều phục; họ ngồi tại sân đạp lúa ở lối vào cổng Sa-ma-ri; và tất cả các nhà tiên tri đang nói tiên tri trước mặt hai vua.
vi.B: Bấy giờ vua Y-sơ-ra-ên và Giô-sa-phát vua Giu-đa đang ngồi trên ngai mình, mặc triều phục. Hai vua ngồi tại sân đạp lúa nơi lối vào cổng thành Sa-ma-ri, và tất cả các nhà tiên tri đang nói tiên tri trước mặt hai vua.
vi.R: Vua Y-sơ-ra-ên và Giô-sa-phát vua Giu-đa mặc triều phục, ngồi trên ngai của mình. Hai vua ngồi tại sân đạp lúa gần lối vào cổng thành Sa-ma-ri. Tất cả các nhà tiên tri đang nói tiên tri trước mặt hai vua.

ko.L: 그리고 이스라엘 왕과 유다 왕 여호사밧은 예복을 입고 각자 자기 왕좌에 앉아 있었다. 그들은 사마리아 성문 어귀의 타작마당에 앉아 있었고, 모든 예언자가 그들 앞에서 예언하고 있었다.
ko.B: 그때 이스라엘 왕과 유다 왕 여호사밧은 왕의 예복을 입고 각자 왕좌에 앉아 있었다. 그들은 사마리아 성문 어귀에 있는 타작마당에 앉아 있었고, 모든 예언자가 그들 앞에서 예언하고 있었다.
ko.R: 이스라엘 왕과 유다 왕 여호사밧은 왕의 예복을 입고 각자 왕좌에 앉아 있었다. 그곳은 사마리아 성문 입구 가까이에 있는 타작마당이었다. 모든 예언자가 그들 앞에서 예언하고 있었다.

pt.L: E o rei de Israel e Josafá, rei de Judá, [estavam] sentados cada um no seu trono, vestidos com [os seus] mantos, e [estavam] sentados na eira, à entrada da porta de Samaria; e todos os profetas [estavam] profetizando diante deles.
pt.B: O rei de Israel e Josafá, rei de Judá, estavam sentados nos seus tronos, vestidos com os seus mantos reais. Estavam sentados na eira junto à entrada da porta de Samaria, e todos os profetas profetizavam diante deles.
pt.R: O rei de Israel e Josafá, rei de Judá, estavam sentados nos seus tronos, vestidos com os seus mantos reais. Eles estavam na eira, perto da entrada da porta da cidade de Samaria. Todos os profetas estavam ali diante deles, profetizando.

decisions.choice: "sitting" said twice, where 1 Kings 22:10 has it once
decisions.reason: Chronicles repeats "and sitting" before "at the threshing floor". The repetition makes clear that the thrones stood at the threshing floor; the scene is the same as in 1 Kings 22:10.

decisions.choice: clothed in garments: wearing royal robes
decisions.reason: "Garments" here are the formal robes of kings seated in state. The scene is a public royal assembly.

decisions.choice: the threshing floor at the gate of Samaria: a broad open space outside the city gate
decisions.reason: A threshing floor was a flat, open area of hard ground. One by the city gate made room for the two kings' thrones and the crowd of four hundred prophets. The gate was the place for public business and judgment.

decisions.choice: prophesying: speaking as prophets, perhaps with ecstatic behavior
decisions.reason: The verb form can describe a prophet's words or the excited behavior that sometimes went with prophecy (1 Samuel 10:5-6; 1 Kings 18:29). Here the next verses show both actions and words.

decisions.choice: royal robes
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable add "royal" to show what kind of robes these were (m2).

decisions.choice: [estavam] sentados (L), Estavam sentados (B), said twice
decisions.reason: Chronicles says "sitting" a second time before the threshing floor (m1); Literal and Balanced repeat it, as the English does, and the rest keeps the Portuguese of 1 Kings 22:10.

records.literal_gloss: And made for himself Zedekiah son of Chenaanah horns of iron, and said, thus says Yahweh, with these you will gore Aram until finishing them.

en.L: And Zedekiah son of Chenaanah made for himself horns of iron and said, "Thus says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}: 'With these you will gore Aram until they are finished.'"
en.B: Zedekiah son of Chenaanah had made himself iron horns, and he said, "{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} says this: 'With these you will gore the Arameans until they are destroyed.'"
en.R: Zedekiah son of Chenaanah had made some horns out of iron. He said, "This is what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} says: 'With horns like these you will gore the Arameans and wipe them out.'"

es.L: Y Sedequías hijo de Quenaana se hizo unos cuernos de hierro y dijo: «Así dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: “Con estos acornearás a Aram hasta acabar con ellos”».
es.B: Sedequías hijo de Quenaana se había hecho unos cuernos de hierro, y dijo: «{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dice esto: “Con estos acornearás a los arameos hasta destruirlos”».
es.R: Sedequías hijo de Quenaana había hecho unos cuernos de hierro. Dijo: «Esto es lo que dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: “Con cuernos como estos acornearás a los arameos y acabarás con ellos”».

fr.L: Et Sédécias fils de Kenaana se fit des cornes de fer et dit : « Ainsi parle {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : “Avec celles-ci tu frapperas Aram jusqu’à les anéantir.” »
fr.B: Sédécias, fils de Kenaana, s’était fait des cornes de fer, et il dit : « {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit ceci : “Avec ces cornes, tu enfonceras les Araméens jusqu’à les détruire.” »
fr.R: Sédécias, fils de Kenaana, avait fabriqué des cornes en fer. Il a dit : « Voici ce que dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : “Avec des cornes comme celles-ci, tu enfonceras les Araméens et tu les anéantiras.” »

sw.L: Sedekia mwana wa Kenaana akajitengenezea pembe za chuma, akasema, "{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asema hivi: 'Kwa hizi utawapiga pembe Aramu mpaka wamalizike.'"
sw.B: Sedekia mwana wa Kenaana alikuwa amejitengenezea pembe za chuma, akasema, "Hivi ndivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asemavyo: 'Kwa hizi utawapiga pembe Waaramu mpaka waangamie.'"
sw.R: Sedekia mwana wa Kenaana alikuwa ametengeneza pembe za chuma. Akasema, "Hili ndilo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} analosema: 'Kwa pembe kama hizi utawapiga Waaramu na kuwaangamiza.'"

vi.L: Sê-đê-kia con trai Kê-na-na làm cho mình những cái sừng bằng sắt và nói: "{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán thế này: 'Với những sừng này, ngươi sẽ húc A-ram cho đến khi chúng bị tiêu diệt.'"
vi.B: Sê-đê-kia con trai Kê-na-na đã làm cho mình những cái sừng bằng sắt, và nói: "{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán như vầy: 'Với những sừng này, vua sẽ húc quân A-ram cho đến khi chúng bị tiêu diệt.'"
vi.R: Sê-đê-kia con trai Kê-na-na đã làm mấy cái sừng bằng sắt. Ông nói: "Đây là lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán: 'Với những cái sừng như thế này, vua sẽ húc quân A-ram và tiêu diệt chúng.'"

ko.L: 그리고 그나아나의 아들 시드기야가 자기를 위해 쇠뿔들을 만들고 말했다. "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이와 같이 말씀하십니다. '네가 이것들로 아람을 찔러 그들을 끝장낼 것이다.'"
ko.B: 그나아나의 아들 시드기야는 쇠로 뿔들을 만들어 가지고 와서 말했다. "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이렇게 말씀하십니다. '너는 이 뿔들로 아람 사람들을 찔러 멸망시킬 것이다.'"
ko.R: 그나아나의 아들 시드기야는 쇠로 뿔들을 만들어 왔다. 그가 말했다. "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하시는 말씀입니다. '너는 이런 뿔로 아람 사람들을 들이받아 모두 없애 버릴 것이다.'"

pt.L: E Zedequias, filho de Quenaaná, fez para si chifres de ferro e disse: "Assim diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}: 'Com estes chifrarás Arã até acabar com eles.'"
pt.B: Zedequias, filho de Quenaaná, tinha feito para si chifres de ferro, e disse: "Assim diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}: 'Com estes chifrarás os arameus até destruí-los.'"
pt.R: Zedequias, filho de Quenaaná, tinha feito uns chifres de ferro. Ele disse: "É isto que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} diz: 'Com chifres como estes vais atacar os arameus e acabar com eles.'"

decisions.choice: the same words as 1 Kings 22:11
decisions.reason: The verse matches 1 Kings 22:11. Zedekiah's name is spelled with a longer ending here, and one verb form differs slightly; neither changes the sense, and the wording is the same as there.

decisions.choice: horns of iron: a sign acted out by the prophet
decisions.reason: Prophets sometimes acted out their message (1 Kings 11:29-31; 2 Kings 13:15-19). The horn of a bull stands for strength and conquest (Deuteronomy 33:17). With iron horns Zedekiah pictures the king as a bull goring Aram to death.

decisions.choice: made: had made, before the scene
decisions.reason: The horns were most likely made before the assembly at the gate, and Zedekiah now shows them; the verb does not require that he made them on the spot.

decisions.choice: Aram: the Aramean people and army
decisions.reason: The country's name stands for its people and army, as the plural "them" at the end shows.

decisions.choice: The LORD says this / This is what the LORD says
decisions.reason: The messenger formula "thus says Yahweh" has one wording at each level in these books. Balanced and Readable name the Arameans (m4).

decisions.choice: the wording of 1 Kings 22:11
decisions.reason: The Hebrew is that of 1 Kings 22:11 (m1), so each level keeps the Portuguese of 1 Kings word for word.

source.text: וְכָל־הַ֨נְּבִאִ֔ים נִבְּאִ֥ים כֵּ֖ן לֵאמֹ֑ר עֲלֵ֞ה רָמֹ֤ת גִּלְעָד֙ וְהַצְלַ֔ח וְנָתַ֥ן יְהוָ֖ה בְּיַ֥ד הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃

records.literal_gloss: And all the prophets [were] prophesying so, saying, go up [to] Ramoth-gilead and succeed, and will give Yahweh [it] into [the] hand of the king.

en.L: And all the prophets [were] prophesying so, saying, "Go up [to] Ramoth-gilead and succeed, and {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will give [it] into the hand of the king."
en.B: All the prophets were prophesying the same thing: "Go up to Ramoth-gilead and be victorious. {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} will give it into the king's hand."
en.R: All the other prophets were saying the same thing: "Attack Ramoth-gilead and win the battle! {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} will help you capture it, Your Majesty."

es.L: Y todos los profetas profetizaban así, diciendo: «Sube [a] Ramot de Galaad y triunfa, porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} [la] entregará en mano del rey».
es.B: Todos los profetas profetizaban lo mismo: «Sube a Ramot de Galaad y triunfa. {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} la entregará en manos del rey».
es.R: Todos los demás profetas decían lo mismo: «¡Ataca Ramot de Galaad y gana la batalla! {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} te ayudará a conquistarla, oh rey».

fr.L: Et tous les prophètes prophétisaient ainsi, en disant : « Monte [à] Ramoth de Galaad et réussis, et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} [la] livrera entre les mains du roi. »
fr.B: Tous les prophètes prophétisaient de même : « Monte à Ramoth de Galaad, et tu seras victorieux. {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} la livrera entre les mains du roi. »
fr.R: Tous les autres prophètes disaient la même chose : « Attaque Ramoth de Galaad, et tu gagneras la bataille ! {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} t’aidera à la prendre, ô roi. »

sw.L: Manabii wote [walikuwa] wakitabiri vivyo hivyo, wakisema, "Panda [uende] Ramoth-gileadi, ufanikiwe, na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} [ataitia] mkononi mwa mfalme."
sw.B: Manabii wote walikuwa wakitabiri jambo lile lile: "Panda Ramoth-gileadi ushinde. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ataitia mkononi mwa mfalme."
sw.R: Manabii wengine wote walikuwa wakisema jambo lile lile: "Ushambulie Ramoth-gileadi na ushinde vita! {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakusaidia kuuteka, Mtukufu mfalme."

vi.L: Tất cả các nhà tiên tri đều nói tiên tri như vậy, rằng: "Xin vua đi lên Ra-mốt Ga-la-át và sẽ thắng, vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ phó [thành ấy] vào tay vua."
vi.B: Tất cả các nhà tiên tri đều nói tiên tri như vậy: "Xin vua đi lên Ra-mốt Ga-la-át và sẽ chiến thắng. {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ phó thành ấy vào tay vua."
vi.R: Tất cả các nhà tiên tri khác cũng nói y như vậy: "Thưa đức vua, xin hãy tấn công Ra-mốt Ga-la-át và đức vua sẽ thắng! {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ giúp đức vua chiếm được thành ấy."

ko.L: 그리고 모든 예언자가 그렇게 예언하며 말했다. "길르앗 라못으로 올라가서 승리하십시오. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 [그것을] 임금님의 손에 넘겨주실 것입니다."
ko.B: 모든 예언자가 똑같이 예언했다. "길르앗 라못으로 올라가서 승리하십시오. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그 성을 임금님의 손에 넘겨주실 것입니다."
ko.R: 다른 예언자들도 모두 똑같이 말했다. "길르앗 라못을 치십시오. 싸움에서 이기실 것입니다! {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 임금님이 그 성을 차지하도록 도와주실 것입니다."

pt.L: E todos os profetas [estavam] profetizando assim, dizendo: "Suba [a] Ramote-Gileade e tenha sucesso, e {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} [a] entregará na mão do rei."
pt.B: Todos os profetas profetizavam a mesma coisa: "Suba a Ramote-Gileade e saia vitorioso. {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} a entregará nas mãos do rei."
pt.R: Todos os outros profetas diziam a mesma coisa: "Ataque Ramote-Gileade e vença a batalha! {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} vai lhe dar a vitória sobre a cidade, Majestade."

decisions.choice: the same words as 1 Kings 22:12
decisions.reason: This verse is word for word the same as 1 Kings 22:12, and its wording here is the same.

decisions.choice: succeed: prosper, win
decisions.reason: The verb means to succeed or prosper; in a battle it means victory. Micaiah repeats the words in verse 14.

decisions.choice: will give into the hand of the king: as in verse 5, now with the divine name
decisions.reason: This time the prophets use the name Yahweh, where in verse 5 they said "God". As in verse 5 the Hebrew leaves the object unstated.

decisions.choice: help you capture it, Your Majesty
decisions.reason: As in verse 5.

decisions.choice: the wording of 1 Kings 22:12
decisions.reason: The Hebrew is that of 1 Kings 22:12 (m1), so each level keeps the Portuguese of 1 Kings word for word.

source.text: וְהַמַּלְאָ֞ךְ אֲשֶׁר־הָלַ֣ךְ׀לִקְרֹ֣א לְמִיכָ֗יְהוּ דִּבֶּ֤ר אֵלָיו֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר הִנֵּ֞ה דִּבְרֵ֧י הַנְּבִאִ֛ים פֶּֽה־אֶחָ֥ד ט֖וֹב אֶל־הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ וִֽיהִי־נָ֧א דְבָרְךָ֛ כְּאַחַ֥ד מֵהֶ֖ם וְדִבַּ֥רְתָּ טּֽוֹב׃

records.literal_gloss: And the messenger who had gone to call Micaiah spoke to him, saying, look, [the] words of the prophets [are with] one mouth good to the king; and let be please your word like one of them, and you will speak good.

en.L: And the messenger who had gone to call Micaiah spoke to him, saying, "Look, the words of the prophets [are] one mouth, good to the king. So let your word, please, be like one of them, and speak good."
en.B: The messenger who had gone to call Micaiah said to him, "Listen, the prophets are all speaking with one voice, and what they say is good for the king. Please let your word be like one of theirs, and speak favorably."
en.R: The messenger who went to get Micaiah said to him, "Listen! All the other prophets agree. They are all promising the king success. Please say the same thing they are saying. Give him a good message."

es.L: Y el mensajero que había ido a llamar a Micaías le habló, diciendo: «Mira, las palabras de los profetas [son] a una boca buenas para el rey. Sea, pues, por favor, tu palabra como la de uno de ellos, y habla bien».
es.B: El mensajero que había ido a llamar a Micaías le dijo: «Escucha, los profetas hablan todos a una voz, y lo que dicen es favorable al rey. Por favor, que tu palabra sea como la de ellos, y habla favorablemente».
es.R: El mensajero que fue a buscar a Micaías le dijo: «¡Escucha! Todos los demás profetas están de acuerdo. Todos le prometen éxito al rey. Por favor, di lo mismo que ellos. Dale un buen mensaje».

fr.L: Et le messager qui était allé appeler Michée lui parla en disant : « Voici, les paroles des prophètes [sont] d’une seule bouche, favorables au roi. Que ta parole, je te prie, soit comme [celle de] l’un d’eux, et dis du bien. »
fr.B: Le messager qui était allé appeler Michée lui dit : « Écoute, les prophètes parlent d’une seule voix, et ce qu’ils disent est favorable au roi. Je t’en prie, que ta parole soit comme la leur, et annonce du bien. »
fr.R: Le messager qui était allé chercher Michée lui a dit : « Écoute ! Tous les autres prophètes sont d’accord. Ils promettent tous la victoire au roi. S’il te plaît, dis la même chose qu’eux. Donne-lui un bon message. »

sw.L: Mjumbe aliyekwenda kumwita Mikaya akasema naye, akisema, "Tazama, maneno ya manabii [ni] kinywa kimoja, mema kwa mfalme. Basi tafadhali, neno lako na liwe kama la mmoja wao, useme mema."
sw.B: Mjumbe aliyekwenda kumwita Mikaya akamwambia, "Sikiliza, manabii wote wanasema kwa sauti moja, na wanayoyasema ni mema kwa mfalme. Tafadhali neno lako na liwe kama la mmoja wao, useme mema."
sw.R: Mjumbe aliyekwenda kumwita Mikaya akamwambia, "Sikiliza! Manabii wengine wote wanakubaliana. Wote wanamwahidi mfalme ushindi. Tafadhali sema kama wanavyosema wao. Mpe ujumbe mzuri."

vi.L: Sứ giả đã đi gọi Mi-chê nói với ông rằng: "Kìa, lời của các nhà tiên tri đồng một miệng, [nói điều] lành cho vua. Xin lời ông cũng như lời của một người trong họ, và hãy nói điều lành."
vi.B: Sứ giả đi gọi Mi-chê nói với ông: "Này, các nhà tiên tri đều đồng một lời nói điều lành cho vua. Xin ông cũng nói như họ, và hãy nói điều lành."
vi.R: Người sứ giả đi gọi Mi-chê nói với ông: "Ông nghe đây! Tất cả các nhà tiên tri khác đều đồng ý với nhau. Họ đều hứa vua sẽ thắng. Xin ông cũng nói giống như họ. Hãy báo cho vua một tin tốt."

ko.L: 그리고 미가야를 부르러 간 사자가 그에게 말했다. "보시오, 예언자들의 말이 한 입으로 왕께 좋게 [말하고 있소]. 부디 당신의 말도 그들 가운데 하나와 같게 하여 좋게 말하시오."
ko.B: 미가야를 부르러 간 사자가 그에게 말했다. "들어 보시오. 예언자들이 모두 한목소리로 왕께 좋은 말을 하고 있소. 당신도 그들처럼 좋게 말해 주시오."
ko.R: 미가야를 데리러 간 사자가 그에게 말했다. "들어 보시오! 다른 예언자들은 모두 한목소리로 왕이 이길 것이라고 하고 있소. 당신도 그들과 똑같이 말해 주시오. 왕에게 좋은 말을 해 주시오."

pt.L: E o mensageiro que tinha ido chamar Micaías lhe falou, dizendo: "Veja, as palavras dos profetas [são] uma só boca, boas para o rei. Que a sua palavra, por favor, seja como um deles, e fale o bem."
pt.B: O mensageiro que tinha ido chamar Micaías lhe disse: "Escute: os profetas estão falando a uma só voz, e o que dizem é bom para o rei. Por favor, que a sua palavra seja como a de um deles; fale coisas favoráveis."
pt.R: O mensageiro que foi buscar Micaías lhe disse: "Escute! Todos os outros profetas concordam. Todos estão prometendo sucesso ao rei. Por favor, diga o mesmo que eles estão dizendo. Dê ao rei uma boa mensagem."

decisions.choice: small differences from 1 Kings 22:13
decisions.reason: Chronicles lacks "please" after "look", joins the request with "and", and says "like one of them" where Kings has "like the word of one of them". The sense is the same as in 1 Kings 22:13.

decisions.choice: one mouth: with one voice, in full agreement
decisions.reason: "One mouth" means that the prophets all say the same thing.

decisions.choice: good: favorable, promising success
decisions.reason: As in verse 7, "good" is a message of success for the king. The messenger presses Micaiah to agree with the others.

decisions.choice: speaking with one voice / all agree
decisions.reason: Balanced uses the English idiom closest to "one mouth"; Readable says what it means (m2).

decisions.choice: The messenger and Micaiah speak to each other in 하오체
decisions.reason: As 1 Kings 22:13-14.

decisions.choice: Veja, as palavras (L); seja como um deles (L)
decisions.reason: As 1 Kings 22:13 in Portuguese, but Chronicles has no "please" after "look" and says "like one of them" (m1), so Literal drops the first "por favor" and "a palavra de"; Balanced and Readable are unchanged.
