records.literal_gloss: And said Micaiah, [by the] life of Yahweh, that what will say my God, it I will speak.

en.L: And Micaiah said, "[As] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} lives, what my God says, that I will speak."
en.B: But Micaiah said, "As surely as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} lives, whatever my God says is what I will speak."
en.R: But Micaiah said, "I promise, as surely as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} lives, I will say only what my God tells me to say."

es.L: Y Micaías dijo: «Vive {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, que lo que mi Dios diga, eso hablaré».
es.B: Pero Micaías dijo: «Tan cierto como que vive {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, lo que mi Dios diga, eso diré».
es.R: Pero Micaías dijo: «Te lo aseguro, tan cierto como que vive {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, diré solamente lo que mi Dios me mande decir».

fr.L: Et Michée dit : « [Aussi vrai que] {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est vivant, ce que mon Dieu dira, c’est cela que je dirai. »
fr.B: Mais Michée répondit : « Aussi vrai que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est vivant, ce que mon Dieu dira, c’est cela que je dirai. »
fr.R: Mais Michée a dit : « Je te le jure, aussi vrai que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est vivant, je dirai seulement ce que mon Dieu me dira de dire. »

sw.L: Mikaya akasema, "Kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aishivyo, lile asemalo Mungu wangu, ndilo nitakalosema."
sw.B: Lakini Mikaya akasema, "Kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aishivyo, lolote asemalo Mungu wangu ndilo nitakalolisema."
sw.R: Lakini Mikaya akasema, "Nakuahidi, kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aishivyo, nitasema tu yale Mungu wangu atakayoniambia niseme."

vi.L: Mi-chê nói: "Thật như {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} hằng sống, điều gì Đức Chúa Trời của tôi phán, tôi sẽ nói điều ấy."
vi.B: Nhưng Mi-chê nói: "Thật như {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} hằng sống, Đức Chúa Trời của tôi phán điều gì, tôi sẽ nói điều ấy."
vi.R: Nhưng Mi-chê nói: "Tôi xin thề, thật như {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} hằng sống, tôi chỉ nói điều Đức Chúa Trời của tôi bảo tôi nói mà thôi."

ko.L: 그러자 미가야가 말했다. "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 살아 계심을 두고 맹세하오. 내 하나님께서 말씀하시는 것, 그것을 내가 말하겠소."
ko.B: 그러나 미가야가 말했다. "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 살아 계심을 두고 맹세하는데, 나는 내 하나님께서 말씀하시는 것만 말하겠소."
ko.R: 그러나 미가야가 말했다. "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 살아 계심을 두고 맹세하는데, 나는 내 하나님께서 말하라고 하시는 것만 말하겠소."

pt.L: E Micaías disse: "[Tão certo como] vive {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o que o meu Deus disser, isso falarei."
pt.B: Mas Micaías disse: "Tão certo como vive {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o que o meu Deus disser, isso é o que falarei."
pt.R: Mas Micaías disse: "Eu prometo: tão certo como {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} vive, vou dizer somente o que o meu Deus me mandar dizer."

decisions.choice: "my God" where 1 Kings 22:14 has "Yahweh ... to me"
decisions.reason: In 1 Kings 22:14 Micaiah says "what Yahweh says to me, that I will speak". Chronicles has "what my God says". The oath itself, "as Yahweh lives", is the same. Calling Yahweh "my God" stresses whose prophet Micaiah is.

decisions.choice: as Yahweh lives: an oath
decisions.reason: Micaiah binds himself by an oath in Yahweh's name, the strongest form of promise. He will not shape his message to please the king.

decisions.choice: what my God says, that I will speak: the mark of a true prophet
decisions.reason: A prophet of Yahweh speaks only the words Yahweh gives him (Numbers 22:38; Deuteronomy 18:18). Micaiah's oath sets him apart from prophets who say what the king wants to hear.

decisions.choice: I promise
decisions.reason: Readable adds "I promise" to show that "as surely as the LORD lives" is an oath (m2).

decisions.choice: "Vive el SEÑOR" (L); "Tan cierto como que vive el SEÑOR" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The oath as the Samuel terms note sets for Spanish; "mi Dios" where 1 Kings 22:14 has the name (meaning decision).

decisions.choice: Kama BWANA aishivyo
decisions.reason: The oath formula of the Samuel terms note.

decisions.choice: "Thật như CHÚA hằng sống"; "Đức Chúa Trời của tôi"
decisions.reason: The oath of the Samuel terms note; Chronicles has "my God" where Kings has the LORD (m1).

decisions.choice: "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 살아 계심을 두고 맹세하오" (the Samuel terms' oath); "내 하나님" where 1 Kings 22:14 has "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}"
decisions.reason: Chronicles' Hebrew says "my God"; Korean changes that word only.

decisions.choice: o que o meu Deus disser
decisions.reason: As 1 Kings 22:14 in Portuguese, with "o meu Deus" where Kings has "o SENHOR ... me" (m1); the oath "Tão certo como vive o SENHOR" keeps its wording.

source.text: וַיָּבֹא֮ אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ֒ וַיֹּ֨אמֶר הַמֶּ֜לֶךְ אֵלָ֗יו מִיכָה֙ הֲנֵלֵ֞ךְ אֶל־רָמֹ֥ת גִּלְעָ֛ד לַמִּלְחָמָ֖ה אִם־אֶחְדָּ֑ל וַיֹּ֨אמֶר֙ עֲל֣וּ וְהַצְלִ֔יחוּ וְיִנָּתְנ֖וּ בְּיֶדְכֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And he came to the king, and said the king to him, Micah, shall we go to Ramoth-gilead for battle, or shall I refrain? And he said, go up and succeed, and they will be given into your hand.

en.L: And he came to the king, and the king said to him, "Micaiah, shall we go to Ramoth-gilead for battle, or shall I refrain?" And he said, "Go up and succeed, and they will be given into your hand."
en.B: When he came to the king, the king asked him, "Micaiah, shall we go to war against Ramoth-gilead, or shall I hold back?" He answered, "Go up and be victorious. They will be given into your hand."
en.R: When Micaiah came, the king said, "Micaiah, should we march on Ramoth-gilead, or not?" Micaiah answered, "Attack and win the battle! Your enemies will be handed over to you."

es.L: Y llegó ante el rey, y el rey le dijo: «Micaías, ¿iremos a Ramot de Galaad a la batalla, o desistiré?». Y él dijo: «{{plural_you:Suban y triunfen|Subid y triunfad}}, porque serán entregados en {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} mano».
es.B: Cuando llegó ante el rey, el rey le preguntó: «Micaías, ¿debemos ir a la guerra contra Ramot de Galaad, o debo desistir?». Él respondió: «{{plural_you:Suban y triunfen|Subid y triunfad}}. Serán entregados en {{plural_you:sus|vuestras}} manos».
es.R: Cuando Micaías llegó, el rey le dijo: «Micaías, ¿debemos atacar Ramot de Galaad, o no?». Micaías respondió: «¡{{plural_you:Ataquen y ganen|Atacad y ganad}} la batalla! {{plural_you:Sus|Vuestros}} enemigos {{plural_you:les|os}} serán entregados».

fr.L: Et il vint vers le roi, et le roi lui dit : « Michée, irons-nous contre Ramoth de Galaad pour combattre, ou m’en abstiendrai-je ? » Et il dit : « Montez et réussissez, et ils seront livrés entre vos mains. »
fr.B: Quand il arriva auprès du roi, celui-ci lui demanda : « Michée, devons-nous partir en guerre contre Ramoth de Galaad, ou dois-je y renoncer ? » Il répondit : « Montez, et vous serez victorieux. Ils seront livrés entre vos mains. »
fr.R: Quand Michée est arrivé, le roi lui a dit : « Michée, devons-nous attaquer Ramoth de Galaad, ou pas ? » Michée a répondu : « Attaquez, et vous gagnerez la bataille ! Vos ennemis vous seront livrés. »

sw.L: Akafika kwa mfalme, naye mfalme akamwambia, "Mikaya, je, twende Ramoth-gileadi vitani, au niache?" Akasema, "Pandeni mfanikiwe, nao watatiwa mkononi mwenu."
sw.B: Alipofika kwa mfalme, mfalme akamwuliza, "Mikaya, je, twende vitani kupigana na Ramoth-gileadi, au nijizuie?" Akajibu, "Pandeni mshinde. Watatiwa mikononi mwenu."
sw.R: Mikaya alipofika, mfalme akasema, "Mikaya, je, twende kuushambulia Ramoth-gileadi, au tusiende?" Mikaya akajibu, "Shambulieni na mshinde vita! Adui zenu watatiwa mikononi mwenu."

vi.L: Ông đến gặp vua, và vua hỏi ông: "Mi-chê, chúng ta có nên đi đánh Ra-mốt Ga-la-át không, hay ta nên thôi?" Ông đáp: "Xin các vua đi lên và sẽ thắng, và chúng sẽ bị phó vào tay các vua."
vi.B: Khi ông đến, vua hỏi: "Mi-chê, chúng ta có nên đi đánh Ra-mốt Ga-la-át không, hay ta nên dừng lại?" Ông đáp: "Xin các vua cứ đi lên và sẽ chiến thắng. Chúng sẽ bị phó vào tay các vua."
vi.R: Khi Mi-chê đến, vua hỏi: "Mi-chê, chúng ta có nên tấn công Ra-mốt Ga-la-át hay không?" Mi-chê trả lời: "Xin cứ tấn công và các vua sẽ thắng! Quân thù sẽ bị phó vào tay các vua."

ko.L: 그리고 그가 왕에게 오자, 왕이 그에게 말했다. "미가야야, 우리가 길르앗 라못으로 싸우러 가야 하겠느냐, 내가 그만두어야 하겠느냐?" 그러자 그가 말했다. "올라가서 승리하십시오. 그들이 임금님의 손에 넘겨질 것입니다."
ko.B: 그가 왕에게 오자 왕이 그에게 물었다. "미가야야, 우리가 길르앗 라못을 치러 가야 하겠느냐, 내가 그만두어야 하겠느냐?" 미가야가 대답했다. "올라가서 승리하십시오. 그들이 임금님의 손에 넘겨질 것입니다."
ko.R: 미가야가 오자 왕이 말했다. "미가야야, 우리가 길르앗 라못을 치러 가야 하겠느냐, 말아야 하겠느냐?" 미가야가 대답했다. "가서 싸우십시오. 이기실 것입니다! 원수들이 임금님의 손에 넘겨질 것입니다."

pt.L: E ele veio ao rei, e o rei lhe disse: "Micaías, iremos a Ramote-Gileade para a batalha, ou desistirei?" E ele disse: "Subam e tenham sucesso, e eles serão entregues na mão de vocês."
pt.B: Quando ele chegou diante do rei, o rei lhe perguntou: "Micaías, devemos ir à guerra contra Ramote-Gileade, ou devo desistir?" Ele respondeu: "Subam e saiam vitoriosos. Eles serão entregues nas mãos de vocês."
pt.R: Quando Micaías chegou, o rei disse: "Micaías, devemos atacar Ramote-Gileade, ou não?" Micaías respondeu: "Ataquem e vençam a batalha! Os inimigos serão entregues a vocês."

decisions.choice: Micaiah's answer differs in its last words from 1 Kings 22:15
decisions.reason: Here the king calls the prophet by the short form of his name, Micah (the same name), and asks "or shall I refrain?" where Kings has "shall we refrain?". Micaiah's answer is addressed to more than one person ("go up" and "succeed" are plural), and it ends "and they will be given into your hand", where 1 Kings 22:15 has "and Yahweh will give it into the hand of the king".

decisions.choice: go up and succeed: the other prophets' words repeated, not Micaiah's real message
decisions.reason: Micaiah answers with the words of the four hundred (verse 11). The king's reply in verse 15 shows that he heard them as mockery, or at least knew they were not what Micaiah had received from Yahweh. Micaiah gives his true message in verse 16.

decisions.choice: plural: Micaiah speaks to both kings; "they" are the enemy
decisions.reason: The commands and "your" are plural: Micaiah answers both kings. "They will be given" has no stated subject; it most likely means the Arameans, or the people of Ramoth-gilead, delivered into the kings' power.

decisions.choice: shall we go ... or shall I refrain?: the king includes Jehoshaphat, then speaks for himself
decisions.reason: As in verse 5, the king first says "we", including Jehoshaphat, then "I".

decisions.choice: Your enemies will be handed over to you
decisions.reason: Readable names who "they" are (m3), which the context suggests but does not state.

decisions.choice: plural_you on Micaiah's answer
decisions.reason: Micaiah's commands and "your" are plural, spoken to both kings (meaning decision), so Spanish uses the plural_you span where the Spanish of 1 Kings 22:15 had "tú".

decisions.choice: "Montez ... vos mains"
decisions.reason: Micaiah's answer here is in the plural (m1), addressed to both kings, so French says "vous", where French Kings has "tu" at 1 Kings 22:15.

decisions.choice: Pandeni mfanikiwe ... mkononi mwenu (plural)
decisions.reason: Here the Hebrew verbs and "your hand" are plural, addressed to both kings, where 1 Kings 22:15 has the singular; Swahili shows the plural in the verbs, as the English cannot.

decisions.choice: "các vua" for the plural "you"
decisions.reason: Micaiah's verbs are plural here: he speaks to both kings (m3), so Vietnamese says "các vua" where 1 Kings 22:15 has the singular.

decisions.choice: Ahab speaks to Micaiah in 해라체; Micaiah answers in 합쇼체
decisions.reason: As 1 Kings 22:15.

decisions.choice: Subam ... vocês (plural); Micaías; desistirei (L), devo desistir (B)
decisions.reason: The king's question follows verse 5 (m4). Micaiah's answer is plural, to both kings, and ends "they will be given into your hand" (m1, m3), so Portuguese says "Subam", "tenham sucesso" and "de vocês" where 1 Kings 22:15 in Portuguese repeats the singular words of the four hundred with "o rei"; Readable names the enemy, as the English does. The short form of the name the king uses is written "Micaías", as the English writes Micaiah.

source.text: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֵלָיו֙ הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ עַד־כַּמֶּ֥ה פְעָמִ֖ים אֲנִ֣י מַשְׁבִּיעֶ֑ךָ אֲ֠שֶׁר לֹֽא־תְדַבֵּ֥ר אֵלַ֛י רַק־אֱמֶ֖ת בְּשֵׁ֥ם יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And said to him the king, until how many times [am] I making you swear that not you will speak to me only truth in [the] name of Yahweh?

en.L: And the king said to him, "How many times must I make you swear that you will speak to me nothing but truth in the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}?"
en.B: But the king said to him, "How often must I put you under oath to tell me only the truth in the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}?"
en.R: But the king said to him, "How often must I say this? Swear in the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} that you will tell me only the truth!"

es.L: Y el rey le dijo: «¿Hasta cuántas veces te haré jurar que no me digas sino la verdad en el nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}?».
es.B: Pero el rey le dijo: «¿Cuántas veces tengo que hacerte jurar que me digas solo la verdad en el nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}?».
es.R: Pero el rey le dijo: «¿Cuántas veces tengo que decírtelo? ¡Jura en el nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} que me dirás solo la verdad!».

fr.L: Et le roi lui dit : « Combien de fois devrai-je te faire jurer de ne me dire que la vérité au nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ? »
fr.B: Mais le roi lui dit : « Combien de fois devrai-je t’adjurer de ne me dire que la vérité au nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ? »
fr.R: Mais le roi lui a dit : « Combien de fois faudra-t-il que je te le dise ? Jure-moi au nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} que tu ne me diras que la vérité ! »

sw.L: Mfalme akamwambia, "Ni mara ngapi nikuapishe kwamba usiniambie ila kweli tu kwa jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}?"
sw.B: Lakini mfalme akamwambia, "Ni mara ngapi nikuapishe uniambie kweli tu kwa jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}?"
sw.R: Lakini mfalme akamwambia, "Ni mara ngapi lazima niseme jambo hili? Apa kwa jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kwamba utaniambia kweli tu!"

vi.L: Vua nói với ông: "Ta phải bắt ông thề bao nhiêu lần để ông nhân danh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} mà chỉ nói sự thật với ta?"
vi.B: Nhưng vua nói với ông: "Ta phải bắt ông thề bao nhiêu lần nữa để ông nhân danh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} mà chỉ nói sự thật với ta?"
vi.R: Nhưng vua nói với ông: "Ta phải nói điều này bao nhiêu lần nữa? Hãy nhân danh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} mà thề rằng ông sẽ chỉ nói sự thật với ta!"

ko.L: 그러자 왕이 그에게 말했다. "너에게 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 이름으로 진실만을 내게 말하라고 내가 몇 번이나 맹세하게 해야 하겠느냐?"
ko.B: 그러자 왕이 그에게 말했다. "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 이름으로 진실만을 말하라고 내가 몇 번이나 너에게 맹세를 시켜야 하겠느냐?"
ko.R: 그러자 왕이 그에게 말했다. "내가 몇 번이나 말해야 하겠느냐? {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 이름으로 맹세하고 나에게 진실만을 말하여라!"

pt.L: E o rei lhe disse: "Até quantas vezes [tenho de] fazer você jurar que não me falará senão a verdade em nome {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}?"
pt.B: Mas o rei lhe disse: "Quantas vezes vou ter de fazer você jurar que me dirá somente a verdade em nome {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}?"
pt.R: Mas o rei lhe disse: "Quantas vezes vou ter de dizer isto? Jure em nome {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} que vai me dizer só a verdade!"

decisions.choice: the same words as 1 Kings 22:16
decisions.reason: The verse matches 1 Kings 22:16 except for a small difference in the form of one verb, and its wording here is the same.

decisions.choice: how many times must I make you swear?: an angry demand, not a real question
decisions.reason: The king is not counting. He is irritated that Micaiah is not giving him Yahweh's real answer, which suggests he knows the earlier answer was not it, and he puts him under oath.

decisions.choice: in the name of Yahweh: speaking as Yahweh's spokesman
decisions.reason: To speak in Yahweh's name is to speak with his authority, as his messenger (Deuteronomy 18:20-22).

decisions.choice: How many times do I have to tell you? Swear ...
decisions.reason: Readable splits the angry question into a question and a command, keeping its force.

decisions.choice: the wording of 1 Kings 22:16

records.literal_gloss: And he said, I saw all Israel scattered on the mountains like the flock which there is not to them a shepherd; and said Yahweh, not masters to these; let them return each to his house in peace.

en.L: And he said, "I saw all Israel scattered on the mountains, \q like sheep that have no shepherd. \q And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said, 'These have no master; \q let them return each to his house in peace.'"
en.B: Then Micaiah said, "I saw all Israel scattered on the hills, \q like sheep that have no shepherd. \q And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said, 'These have no master; \q let each of them go home in peace.'"
en.R: Then Micaiah said, "I saw the whole army of Israel scattered over the hills, \q like sheep without anyone to shepherd them. \q And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said, 'These men have no master now. \q Let each of them go home in peace.'"

es.L: Y él dijo: «Vi a todo Israel esparcido por los montes, \q como ovejas que no tienen pastor. \q Y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dijo: “Estos no tienen señor; \q que vuelva cada uno a su casa en paz”».
es.B: Entonces Micaías dijo: «Vi a todo Israel esparcido por los montes, \q como ovejas que no tienen pastor. \q Y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dijo: “Estos no tienen señor; \q que cada uno vuelva a su casa en paz”».
es.R: Entonces Micaías dijo: «Vi a todo el ejército de Israel esparcido por los montes, \q como ovejas sin nadie que las cuide. \q Y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dijo: “Estos hombres ya no tienen señor. \q Que cada uno vuelva a su casa en paz”».

fr.L: Et il dit : « J’ai vu tout Israël dispersé sur les montagnes, \q comme des brebis qui n’ont pas de berger. \q Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a dit : “Ceux-ci n’ont pas de maître ; \q qu’ils retournent chacun dans sa maison en paix.” »
fr.B: Alors Michée dit : « J’ai vu tout Israël dispersé sur les montagnes, \q comme des brebis qui n’ont pas de berger. \q Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a dit : “Ils n’ont plus de maître ; \q que chacun rentre chez soi en paix.” »
fr.R: Alors Michée a dit : « J’ai vu toute l’armée d’Israël dispersée sur les collines, \q comme des brebis sans personne pour les garder. \q Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a dit : “Ces hommes n’ont plus de maître maintenant. \q Que chacun rentre chez lui en paix.” »

sw.L: Akasema, "Niliwaona Israeli wote wametawanyika milimani, \q kama kondoo wasio na mchungaji. \q Naye {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akasema, 'Hawa hawana bwana; \q na warudi kila mtu nyumbani kwake kwa amani.'"
sw.B: Ndipo Mikaya akasema, "Niliwaona Israeli wote wametawanyika juu ya vilima, \q kama kondoo wasio na mchungaji. \q Naye {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akasema, 'Hawa hawana bwana; \q kila mmoja wao na arudi nyumbani kwa amani.'"
sw.R: Ndipo Mikaya akasema, "Nililiona jeshi lote la Israeli limetawanyika juu ya vilima, \q kama kondoo wasio na mtu wa kuwachunga. \q Naye {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akasema, 'Watu hawa hawana bwana sasa. \q Kila mmoja wao na arudi nyumbani kwa amani.'"

vi.L: Ông nói: "Tôi thấy cả Y-sơ-ra-ên tản lạc trên các núi, \q như bầy chiên không có người chăn. \q {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán: 'Những người này không có chủ; \q mỗi người hãy trở về nhà mình bình an.'"
vi.B: Bấy giờ Mi-chê nói: "Tôi thấy cả Y-sơ-ra-ên tản lạc trên các đồi núi, \q như bầy chiên không có người chăn. \q Và {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán: 'Những người này không có chủ; \q mỗi người hãy về nhà mình bình an.'"
vi.R: Bấy giờ Mi-chê nói: "Tôi thấy toàn quân Y-sơ-ra-ên tản lạc khắp các đồi núi, \q như bầy chiên không có ai chăn dắt. \q Và {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán: 'Những người này nay không còn chủ. \q Mỗi người hãy về nhà mình bình an.'"

ko.L: 그러자 그가 말했다. "제가 보니 온 이스라엘이 산 위에 흩어져 있었습니다. \q 목자 없는 양 떼 같았습니다. \q 그리고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 말씀하셨습니다. '이들에게는 주인이 없다. \q 각자 평안히 자기 집으로 돌아가게 하여라.'"
ko.B: 그러자 미가야가 말했다. "제가 보니 온 이스라엘이 산 위에 흩어져 있었습니다. \q 목자 없는 양 떼 같았습니다. \q 그리고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 말씀하셨습니다. '이들에게는 주인이 없다. \q 저마다 평안히 집으로 돌아가게 하여라.'"
ko.R: 그러자 미가야가 말했다. "제가 보니 이스라엘 온 군대가 산 위에 흩어져 있었습니다. \q 돌보아 줄 목자가 없는 양 떼 같았습니다. \q 그리고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 말씀하셨습니다. '이 사람들에게는 이제 주인이 없다. \q 저마다 평안히 집으로 돌아가게 하여라.'"

pt.L: E ele disse: "Vi todo Israel disperso pelos montes, \q como ovelhas que não têm pastor. \q E {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} disse: 'Estes não têm senhor; \q que voltem, cada um para a sua casa, em paz.'"
pt.B: Então Micaías disse: "Vi todo Israel disperso pelos montes, \q como ovelhas sem pastor. \q E {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} disse: 'Estes não têm senhor; \q que cada um volte para casa em paz.'"
pt.R: Então Micaías disse: "Vi todo o exército de Israel espalhado pelos montes, \q como ovelhas sem um pastor para cuidar delas. \q E {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} disse: 'Estes homens já não têm senhor. \q Que cada um volte para casa em paz.'"

decisions.choice: the same vision as 1 Kings 22:17
decisions.reason: The verse matches 1 Kings 22:17, with only small differences of spelling, and the wording here is the same, set in the same lines.

decisions.choice: like sheep that have no shepherd: a people whose king is gone
decisions.reason: A king was the shepherd of his people. Moses asked Yahweh for a leader so that his people would not be "like sheep that have no shepherd" (Numbers 27:17). Micaiah sees Israel's army scattered after the battle, leaderless: the king will die.

decisions.choice: these have no master; let them return in peace: the soldiers go home unharmed, without their king
decisions.reason: "Master" (literally "masters", a plural used for one lord) here is the king. The army will not be destroyed; it will go home, but without him (1 Kings 22:36).

decisions.choice: a vision set as a short poem
decisions.reason: Micaiah reports what he saw and heard in two balanced pairs of lines, the form prophets often used for their messages.

decisions.choice: all Israel: Israel's army in the field
decisions.reason: The scattered flock is the army Ahab leads to Ramoth-gilead.

decisions.choice: the whole army of Israel / These men ... now
decisions.reason: Readable makes explicit that the vision is of the army (m5) and that "no master" refers to what will happen after the battle (m3).

decisions.choice: the vision set in lines, as 1 Kings 22:17
decisions.reason: The English sets Micaiah's vision as a short poem at each level, so the Spanish keeps the lines and wording of 1 Kings 22:17.

decisions.choice: The vision set in four lines at every level, as the English and 1 Kings 22:17
decisions.reason: The English levels set Micaiah's vision in lines.

decisions.choice: the wording of 1 Kings 22:17
decisions.reason: The Hebrew is that of 1 Kings 22:17 (m1), so each level keeps the Portuguese of 1 Kings word for word. "Como ovelhas que não têm pastor" (L) and the poetry lines are as there.

source.text: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר מֶֽלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל אֶל־יְהוֹשָׁפָ֑ט הֲלֹא֙ אָמַ֣רְתִּי אֵלֶ֔יךָ לֹא־יִתְנַבֵּ֥א עָלַ֛י ט֖וֹב כִּ֥י אִם־לְרָֽע׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And said [the] king of Israel to Jehoshaphat, did not I say to you, not he prophesies concerning me good but only for evil?

en.L: And the king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, "Did I not say to you, 'He does not prophesy good concerning me, but only evil'?"
en.B: The king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, "Did I not say to you that he prophesies nothing good about me, only bad?"
en.R: The king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, "I told you so! He never says anything good about me. He only predicts trouble."

es.L: Y el rey de Israel dijo a Josafat: «¿No te dije yo: “No profetiza acerca de mí el bien, sino solo el mal”?».
es.B: El rey de Israel le dijo a Josafat: «¿No te dije que no profetiza nada bueno acerca de mí, sino solo lo malo?».
es.R: El rey de Israel le dijo a Josafat: «¡Te lo dije! Nunca dice nada bueno de mí. Solo me anuncia desgracias».

fr.L: Et le roi d’Israël dit à Josaphat : « Ne te l’avais-je pas dit : “Il ne prophétise pas du bien sur moi, mais seulement du mal” ? »
fr.B: Le roi d’Israël dit à Josaphat : « Ne t’avais-je pas dit qu’il ne prophétise rien de bon sur moi, seulement du mal ? »
fr.R: Le roi d’Israël a dit à Josaphat : « Je te l’avais bien dit ! Il ne dit jamais rien de bon sur moi. Il ne m’annonce que des malheurs. »

sw.L: Mfalme wa Israeli akamwambia Yehoshafati, "Je, sikukuambia, 'Hanitabirii mema, ila mabaya tu'?"
sw.B: Mfalme wa Israeli akamwambia Yehoshafati, "Je, sikukuambia kwamba hanitabirii lolote jema, ila mabaya tu?"
sw.R: Mfalme wa Israeli akamwambia Yehoshafati, "Nilikuambia! Kamwe hasemi jambo jema juu yangu. Hunitabiria taabu tu."

vi.L: Vua Y-sơ-ra-ên nói với Giô-sa-phát: "Tôi đã chẳng nói với vua rằng hắn không nói tiên tri điều lành về tôi, mà chỉ điều dữ sao?"
vi.B: Vua Y-sơ-ra-ên nói với Giô-sa-phát: "Tôi đã chẳng nói với vua rằng hắn không bao giờ nói tiên tri điều lành về tôi, mà chỉ toàn điều dữ sao?"
vi.R: Vua Y-sơ-ra-ên nói với Giô-sa-phát: "Tôi đã nói với vua mà! Hắn chẳng bao giờ nói điều gì tốt về tôi. Hắn chỉ toàn báo điều xấu."

ko.L: 그러자 이스라엘 왕이 여호사밧에게 말했다. "그가 나에 대해 좋은 것은 예언하지 않고 나쁜 것만 예언한다고 내가 당신에게 말하지 않았소?"
ko.B: 이스라엘 왕이 여호사밧에게 말했다. "그가 나에 대해 좋은 것은 하나도 예언하지 않고 나쁜 것만 예언한다고 내가 말하지 않았소?"
ko.R: 이스라엘 왕이 여호사밧에게 말했다. "내가 뭐라고 했소! 그는 나에 대해 좋은 말은 한 번도 하지 않소. 언제나 나쁜 일만 생긴다고 하오."

pt.L: E o rei de Israel disse a Josafá: "Não lhe disse eu: 'Ele não profetiza a meu respeito o bem, mas só o mal'?"
pt.B: O rei de Israel disse a Josafá: "Não lhe disse que ele não profetiza nada de bom a meu respeito, só coisas más?"
pt.R: O rei de Israel disse a Josafá: "Eu não falei? Ele nunca diz nada de bom a meu respeito. Só anuncia desgraças."

decisions.choice: "but only evil": the same complaint as 1 Kings 22:18
decisions.reason: Chronicles reads "but only for evil" where Kings has "but evil". The sense is the same.

decisions.choice: did I not say to you?: "I told you"
decisions.reason: The question expects agreement. The king turns Micaiah's warning into proof of personal hostility (verse 7) instead of hearing it as Yahweh's word.

decisions.choice: I told you so!
decisions.reason: Readable states as a fact what the king asks as a question (m2). "Bad" and "trouble" as in verse 7.

decisions.choice: mas só o mal (L)
decisions.reason: As 1 Kings 22:18 in Portuguese, with "só" at Literal for Chronicles' "but only for evil" (m1); Balanced and Readable already say "só" there.

source.text: וַיֹּ֕אמֶר לָכֵ֖ן שִׁמְע֣וּ דְבַר־יְהוָ֑ה רָאִ֤יתִי אֶת־יְהוָה֙ יוֹשֵׁ֣ב עַל־כִּסְא֔וֹ וְכָל־צְבָ֤א הַשָּׁמַ֨יִם֙ עֹֽמְדִ֔ים עַל־יְמִינ֖וֹ וּשְׂמֹאלֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And he said, therefore hear [the] word of Yahweh: I saw Yahweh sitting on his throne, and all [the] host of the heavens standing on his right and his left.

en.L: And he said, "Therefore hear the word of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}: I saw {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} sitting on {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} throne, and all the host of heaven standing on {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} right and {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} left.
en.B: Micaiah went on, "Then hear the word of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. I saw {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} seated on {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} throne, with all the host of heaven standing at {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} right and at {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} left.
en.R: Micaiah said, "Then listen to what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} says. I saw {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} sitting on {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} throne. All the armies of heaven were standing on {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} right side and on {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} left.

es.L: Y dijo: «Por tanto, {{plural_you:oigan|oíd}} la palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}: Vi {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} sentado en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} trono, y todo el ejército de los cielos estaba de pie a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} derecha y a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} izquierda.
es.B: Micaías continuó: «Entonces {{plural_you:oigan|oíd}} la palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. Vi {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} sentado en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} trono, con todo el ejército del cielo de pie a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} derecha y a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} izquierda.
es.R: Micaías dijo: «Entonces {{plural_you:escuchen|escuchad}} lo que dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}. Vi {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} sentado en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} trono. Todos los ejércitos del cielo estaban de pie a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} lado derecho y a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} izquierdo.

fr.L: Et il dit : « C’est pourquoi écoutez la parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} : j’ai vu {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} assis sur {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} trône, et toute l’armée des cieux se tenait à {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} droite et à {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} gauche.
fr.B: Michée reprit : « Eh bien, écoutez la parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. J’ai vu {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} assis sur {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} trône, et toute l’armée des cieux se tenait à {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} droite et à {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} gauche.
fr.R: Michée a dit : « Alors écoutez ce que dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. J’ai vu {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} assis sur {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} trône. Toutes les armées du ciel se tenaient à {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} droite et à {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} gauche.

sw.L: Akasema, "Basi lisikieni neno la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}: Nilimwona {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ameketi juu ya kiti {{deity_pronoun:chake|Chake}} cha enzi, na jeshi lote la mbinguni limesimama upande {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} wa kulia na upande {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} wa kushoto.
sw.B: Mikaya akaendelea, "Basi sikieni neno la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. sw.R: Mikaya akasema, "Basi sikilizeni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anachosema. Nilimwona {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ameketi juu ya kiti {{deity_pronoun:chake|Chake}} cha enzi. Majeshi yote ya mbinguni yalikuwa yamesimama upande {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} wa kulia na upande {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} wa kushoto.

vi.L: Mi-chê nói: "Vậy hãy nghe lời của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}: Tôi thấy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ngồi trên ngai {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, và cả đạo binh trên trời đứng bên phải và bên trái {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Mi-chê nói tiếp: "Vậy xin hãy nghe lời của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Tôi thấy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ngồi trên ngai {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, cả đạo binh trên trời đứng bên phải và bên trái {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Mi-chê nói: "Vậy xin hãy nghe điều {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán. Tôi thấy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ngồi trên ngai {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Tất cả các đạo quân trên trời đứng bên phải và bên trái {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 그러자 그가 말했다. "그러므로 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말씀을 들으십시오. 제가 보니 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그분의 왕좌에 앉아 계시고, 하늘의 모든 군대가 그분의 오른쪽과 왼쪽에 서 있었습니다.
ko.B: 미가야가 말을 이었다. "그렇다면 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말씀을 들으십시오. 제가 보니 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 왕좌에 앉아 계시고, 하늘의 모든 군대가 그분의 오른쪽과 왼쪽에 둘러서 있었습니다.
ko.R: 미가야가 말했다. "그렇다면 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하시는 말씀을 들으십시오. 제가 보니 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 왕좌에 앉아 계셨습니다. 하늘의 모든 군대가 그분의 오른쪽과 왼쪽에 둘러서 있었습니다.

pt.L: E ele disse: "Por isso, ouçam a palavra {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}: vi {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} sentado no {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} trono, e todo o exército dos céus de pé à {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} direita e à {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} esquerda.
pt.B: Micaías continuou: "Então ouçam a palavra {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}. Vi {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} sentado no {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} trono, com todo o exército dos céus de pé à {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} direita e à {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} esquerda.
pt.R: Micaías disse: "Então escutem o que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} diz. Eu vi {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} sentado no {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} trono. Todos os exércitos do céu estavam de pé à {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} direita e à {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} esquerda.

decisions.choice: small differences from 1 Kings 22:19
decisions.reason: Chronicles has "hear" in the plural, addressed to both kings, and says the host stood "on his right and his left", where Kings has "standing by him, on his right and on his left". The vision is the same.

decisions.choice: I saw Yahweh on his throne: a vision of Yahweh's heavenly court
decisions.reason: Micaiah tells of a vision in which he saw Yahweh as a king holding court, surrounded by his attendants. Isaiah saw Yahweh on his throne in a similar way (Isaiah 6:1-8), and Job 1:6 and 2:1 describe heavenly beings presenting themselves before Yahweh. Micaiah claims to have stood in that council (compare Jeremiah 23:18, 22), unlike the other prophets.

decisions.choice: the host of heaven: the heavenly beings who serve Yahweh
decisions.reason: "Host" means an army. Here the host of heaven is Yahweh's company of heavenly attendants, gathered around his throne like the officials of a royal court. Elsewhere the same phrase can mean the stars (Deuteronomy 4:19).

decisions.choice: therefore: because you will not listen, hear what I saw
decisions.reason: Micaiah answers the king's charge of hostility (verse 17) by explaining where his message came from.

decisions.choice: all the armies of heaven
decisions.reason: Readable says "armies" for "host", the same word used in the title "the LORD of Armies" in these books (m3).

decisions.choice: {{plural_you:oigan|oíd}}
decisions.reason: Chronicles has "hear" in the plural, spoken to both kings (meaning decision), so Spanish uses the plural_you span where 1 Kings 22:19 had "oye".

decisions.choice: lisikieni; sikieni; sikilizeni (plural)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew imperative here is plural, addressed to both kings, where 1 Kings 22:19 has the singular; Swahili shows it in the verb.

decisions.choice: ouçam / escutem (plural); o exército dos céus (L, B), os exércitos do céu (R); without "junto a ele"
decisions.reason: As 1 Kings 22:19 in Portuguese ("o exército dos céus", m3), with Chronicles' changes (m1): the host stands "on his right and his left" without "by him", and "hear" is plural, to both kings, which Portuguese must show: "ouçam" (L, B), "escutem" (R), where Kings has "ouça".

source.text: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יְהוָ֗ה מִ֤י יְפַתֶּה֙ אֶת־אַחְאָ֣ב מֶֽלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְיַ֕עַל וְיִפֹּ֖ל בְּרָמ֣וֹת גִּלְעָ֑ד וַיֹּ֕אמֶר זֶ֚ה אֹמֵ֣ר כָּ֔כָה וְזֶ֖ה אֹמֵ֥ר כָּֽכָה׃

records.literal_gloss: And said Yahweh, who will entice Ahab king of Israel, and he will go up and fall at Ramoth-gilead? And said this [one], saying thus, and this [one] saying thus.

en.L: And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said, 'Who will entice Ahab king of Israel, so that he goes up and falls at Ramoth-gilead?' And one spoke, saying one thing, and another was saying another.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} said, 'Who will entice Ahab king of Israel to go up and fall at Ramoth-gilead?' Some suggested one thing and some another.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} asked, 'Who will trick Ahab king of Israel into attacking Ramoth-gilead, so that he will die there?' One of them suggested one thing, and another suggested something else.

es.L: Y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dijo: “¿Quién inducirá a Acab rey de Israel, para que suba y caiga en Ramot de Galaad?”. Y uno decía así, y otro decía así.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dijo: “¿Quién inducirá a Acab rey de Israel a subir y caer en Ramot de Galaad?”. Unos proponían una cosa, y otros otra.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} preguntó: “¿Quién engañará a Acab rey de Israel para que ataque Ramot de Galaad, y muera allí?”. Uno de ellos propuso una cosa, y otro propuso otra.

fr.L: Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a dit : “Qui séduira Achab, roi d’Israël, pour qu’il monte et qu’il tombe à Ramoth de Galaad ?” Et l’un disait ceci, et l’autre disait cela.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a dit : “Qui séduira Achab, roi d’Israël, pour qu’il monte à Ramoth de Galaad et qu’il y tombe ?” Les uns proposaient une chose, les autres une autre.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a demandé : “Qui va tromper Achab, roi d’Israël, pour qu’il attaque Ramoth de Galaad et qu’il y meure ?” L’un proposait une chose, et un autre proposait autre chose.

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akasema, 'Ni nani atakayemshawishi Ahabu mfalme wa Israeli, ili apande na kuanguka huko Ramoth-gileadi?' Huyu akasema hivi, na huyu akisema hivi.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akasema, 'Ni nani atakayemshawishi Ahabu mfalme wa Israeli apande na kuanguka huko Ramoth-gileadi?' Wengine wakashauri hili na wengine lile.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akauliza, 'Ni nani atakayemdanganya Ahabu mfalme wa Israeli aende kuushambulia Ramoth-gileadi, ili afe huko?' Mmoja wao akashauri jambo moja, na mwingine jambo lingine.

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán: 'Ai sẽ dụ dỗ A-háp vua Y-sơ-ra-ên để hắn đi lên và ngã chết tại Ra-mốt Ga-la-át?' Người này nói thế này, người kia nói thế kia.
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán: 'Ai sẽ dụ A-háp vua Y-sơ-ra-ên đi lên để ngã chết tại Ra-mốt Ga-la-át?' Người thì đề nghị cách này, người thì đề nghị cách khác.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} hỏi: 'Ai sẽ lừa A-háp vua Y-sơ-ra-ên đi đánh Ra-mốt Ga-la-át để hắn chết tại đó?' Người này đề nghị một cách, người kia đề nghị cách khác.

ko.L: 그리고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 말씀하셨습니다. '누가 이스라엘 왕 아합을 꾀어 그가 올라가서 길르앗 라못에서 쓰러지게 하겠느냐?' 그러자 이 자는 이렇게 말하고 저 자는 저렇게 말했습니다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 말씀하셨습니다. '누가 이스라엘 왕 아합을 꾀어 길르앗 라못으로 올라가 거기서 쓰러지게 하겠느냐?' 그러자 이쪽에서는 이렇게, 저쪽에서는 저렇게 말했습니다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 물으셨습니다. '누가 이스라엘 왕 아합을 속여서 길르앗 라못을 치러 가게 하여 거기서 죽게 하겠느냐?' 그러자 어떤 이는 이렇게 하자고 하고, 또 어떤 이는 저렇게 하자고 했습니다.

pt.L: E {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} disse: 'Quem enganará Acabe, rei de Israel, para que ele suba e caia em Ramote-Gileade?' E um falou, dizendo uma coisa, e outro dizia outra.
pt.B: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} disse: 'Quem vai enganar Acabe, rei de Israel, para que ele suba e caia em Ramote-Gileade?' Uns sugeriam uma coisa, e outros, outra.
pt.R: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} perguntou: 'Quem vai enganar Acabe, rei de Israel, para que ele ataque Ramote-Gileade e morra lá?' Um deles sugeriu uma coisa, e outro sugeriu outra.

decisions.choice: "Ahab king of Israel" where 1 Kings 22:20 has "Ahab"
decisions.reason: Chronicles gives Ahab his title, and it words the council's answers a little differently ("one said, saying thus, and another saying thus"). The sense is the same as in 1 Kings 22:20.

decisions.choice: entice: lure, persuade by deceiving
decisions.reason: The verb means to persuade someone, often by deception, to do what will harm him (Judges 14:15; 16:5; Jeremiah 20:7). It is used again in verses 20-21.

decisions.choice: fall: die in battle
decisions.reason: To fall at a place is to be killed there in battle.

decisions.choice: trick ... into attacking ... so that he will die there
decisions.reason: Readable says "trick" for "entice" (m2) and says plainly what "go up and fall" means (m3).

decisions.choice: "inducirá" (L, B); "engañará" (R)
decisions.reason: As the Spanish of 1 Kings 22:20: the verb means to lure by deceit; "inducir" keeps the persuading at Literal and Balanced, Readable says "engañar".

decisions.choice: Acabe, rei de Israel; E um dizia assim, e outro dizia assim (L)
decisions.reason: As 1 Kings 22:20 in Portuguese ("enganar" at every level, m2), with Ahab's title added and the council's answers in Chronicles' words (m1).

source.text: וַיֵּצֵ֣א הָר֗וּחַ וַֽיַּעֲמֹד֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה וַיֹּ֖אמֶר אֲנִ֣י אֲפַתֶּ֑נּוּ וַיֹּ֧אמֶר יְהוָ֛ה אֵלָ֖יו בַּמָּֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And came out the spirit and stood before Yahweh, and said, I will entice him. And said Yahweh to him, by what?

en.L: And the spirit came out and stood before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and said, 'I will entice him.' And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said to him, 'By what [means]?'
en.B: Then a spirit came forward and stood before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and said, 'I will entice him.' {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} asked him, 'How?'
en.R: Then a spirit came forward and stood in front of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. The spirit said, 'I will trick him.' {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} asked, 'How will you do it?'

es.L: Y salió el espíritu y se puso delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y dijo: “Yo lo induciré”. Y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} le dijo: “¿Con qué?”.
es.B: Entonces un espíritu se adelantó, se puso delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y dijo: “Yo lo induciré”. {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} le preguntó: “¿Cómo?”.
es.R: Entonces un espíritu se adelantó y se puso delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. El espíritu dijo: “Yo lo engañaré”. {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} le preguntó: “¿Cómo lo harás?”.

fr.L: Et l’esprit sortit, se tint devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} et dit : “Moi, je le séduirai.” Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} lui dit : “Par quel [moyen] ?”
fr.B: Alors un esprit s’avança, se tint devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} et dit : “Moi, je le séduirai.” {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} lui demanda : “Comment ?”
fr.R: Alors un esprit s’est avancé et s’est tenu devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. Il a dit : “Moi, je vais le tromper.” {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} lui a demandé : “Comment vas-tu faire ?”

sw.L: Ndipo roho akatoka, akasimama mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, akasema, 'Mimi nitamshawishi.' {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akamwambia, 'Kwa [njia] gani?'
sw.B: Kisha roho mmoja akajitokeza, akasimama mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, akasema, 'Mimi nitamshawishi.' {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akamwuliza, 'Kwa namna gani?'
sw.R: Kisha roho mmoja akajitokeza, akasimama mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Roho huyo akasema, 'Mimi nitamdanganya.' {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akauliza, 'Utafanyaje?'

vi.L: Thần linh kia bước ra, đứng trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và nói: 'Tôi sẽ dụ dỗ hắn.' {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} hỏi nó: 'Bằng cách nào?'
vi.B: Bấy giờ có một thần linh bước ra, đứng trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và thưa: 'Tôi sẽ dụ hắn.' {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} hỏi: 'Bằng cách nào?'
vi.R: Rồi một thần linh bước ra, đứng trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Thần linh ấy thưa: 'Tôi sẽ lừa hắn.' {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} hỏi: 'Ngươi sẽ làm thế nào?'

ko.L: 그때 그 영이 나와서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에 서서 말했습니다. '제가 그를 꾀겠습니다.' 그러자 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그에게 말씀하셨습니다. '무엇으로?'
ko.B: 그때 한 영이 나와서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에 서서 말했습니다. '제가 그를 꾀겠습니다.' {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그에게 물으셨습니다. '어떻게 하겠느냐?'
ko.R: 그때 한 영이 나와서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에 섰습니다. 그 영이 말했습니다. '제가 그를 속이겠습니다.' {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 물으셨습니다. '어떻게 하겠느냐?'

pt.L: E o espírito saiu e se pôs diante {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} e disse: 'Eu o enganarei.' E {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} lhe disse: 'Com quê?'
pt.B: Então um espírito se apresentou, ficou de pé diante {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} e disse: 'Eu o enganarei.' {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} lhe perguntou: 'Como?'
pt.R: Então um espírito se apresentou e ficou de pé diante {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}. O espírito disse: 'Eu vou enganá-lo.' {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} perguntou: 'Como vais fazer isso?'

decisions.choice: the same words as 1 Kings 22:21
decisions.reason: This verse is word for word the same as 1 Kings 22:21, and its wording here is the same. Unlike there, where many Bibles begin a new verse with the question "By what?", the verse numbering here is the same in the Hebrew text and in other Bibles.

decisions.choice: the spirit: one of the heavenly beings in Yahweh's court
alternatives: a spirit known for this task
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "the spirit", with "the". It may mean simply the particular spirit who stepped forward from the host of verse 18, or a spirit known for this work, or the spirit that moves prophets to speak (compare verse 23). It is not identified further. Spirits sent by God on a task of judgment appear also in Judges 9:23 and 1 Samuel 16:14.

decisions.choice: a spirit
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "a spirit": in English "the spirit" here would suggest a spirit already mentioned or the Spirit of God, and none has been named. Literal keeps the Hebrew "the" (m2).

decisions.choice: the wording of 1 Kings 22:21
decisions.reason: The Hebrew is that of 1 Kings 22:21 (m1), so each level keeps the Portuguese of 1 Kings word for word.

source.text: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר אֵצֵא֙ וְהָיִ֨יתִי֙ לְר֣וּחַ שֶׁ֔קֶר בְּפִ֖י כָּל־נְבִיאָ֑יו וַיֹּ֗אמֶר תְּפַתֶּה֙ וְגַם־תּוּכָ֔ל צֵ֖א וַעֲשֵׂה־כֵֽן׃

records.literal_gloss: And he said, I will go out and I will be as a spirit of falsehood in [the] mouth of all his prophets. And he said, you will entice and also you will prevail; go out and do so.

en.L: And he said, 'I will go out, and I will be a lying spirit in the mouth of all his prophets.' And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said, 'You will entice [him], and you will also succeed; go out and do so.'
en.B: He said, 'I will go out and be a lying spirit in the mouth of all his prophets.' {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} said, 'You will entice him, and you will succeed. Go and do it.'
en.R: The spirit said, 'I will go out and make all of Ahab's prophets tell lies.' {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} said, 'You will trick him, and you will succeed. Go and do it.'

es.L: Y él dijo: “Saldré, y seré espíritu de mentira en la boca de todos sus profetas”. Y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} dijo: “[Lo] inducirás, y también prevalecerás; sal y hazlo así”.
es.B: Él dijo: “Saldré y seré un espíritu de mentira en la boca de todos sus profetas”. {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dijo: “Lo inducirás, y lo lograrás. Ve y hazlo”.
es.R: El espíritu dijo: “Saldré y haré que todos los profetas de Acab digan mentiras”. {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dijo: “Lo engañarás, y lo lograrás. Ve y hazlo”.

fr.L: Et il dit : “Je sortirai, et je serai un esprit de mensonge dans la bouche de tous ses prophètes.” Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} dit : “Tu [le] séduiras, et tu réussiras aussi ; sors et fais ainsi.”
fr.B: Il répondit : “Je sortirai et je serai un esprit de mensonge dans la bouche de tous ses prophètes.” {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit : “Tu le séduiras, et tu réussiras. Va, et fais-le.”
fr.R: L’esprit a dit : “Je vais sortir et faire mentir tous les prophètes d’Achab.” {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a dit : “Tu le tromperas, et tu réussiras. Va, et fais-le.”

sw.L: Akasema, 'Nitatoka, nami nitakuwa roho ya uongo katika kinywa cha manabii wake wote.' Akasema, 'Utamshawishi, nawe utafaulu pia; toka ukafanye hivyo.'
sw.B: Akasema, 'Nitatoka niwe roho ya uongo katika kinywa cha manabii wake wote.' {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akasema, 'Utamshawishi, nawe utafaulu. Nenda ukafanye hivyo.'
sw.R: Roho huyo akasema, 'Nitatoka niwafanye manabii wote wa Ahabu waseme uongo.' {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akasema, 'Utamdanganya, nawe utafaulu. Nenda ukafanye hivyo.'

vi.L: Nó nói: 'Tôi sẽ đi ra và làm một thần nói dối trong miệng tất cả các nhà tiên tri của hắn.' Ngài phán: 'Ngươi sẽ dụ dỗ [hắn] và cũng sẽ thành công; hãy đi ra làm như vậy.'
vi.B: Thần linh ấy thưa: 'Tôi sẽ đi ra làm một thần nói dối trong miệng tất cả các nhà tiên tri của hắn.' {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán: 'Ngươi sẽ dụ được hắn, và ngươi sẽ thành công. Hãy đi làm như vậy.'

decisions.choice: a lying spirit in the mouth of all his prophets: Yahweh lets a spirit deceive Ahab's prophets, as judgment on Ahab
alternatives: Yahweh actively sends the deceiving spirit
Yahweh permits a deception Ahab has chosen
the council scene is a vision-picture of Yahweh's judgment
decisions.reason: In Micaiah's vision Yahweh himself asks who will lure Ahab to his death, and he sends the spirit who offers to make Ahab's prophets lie. The passage presents this as Yahweh's judgment on Ahab, which Kings says was already announced for his murder of Naboth (1 Kings 21:19-24). Ahab had long preferred prophets who told him what he wanted to hear (verse 7), and the deception confirms the choice he had made. Yet by telling Ahab the whole vision, Yahweh, through Micaiah, warns him plainly and leaves him free to stay home (verses 22, 27). Scripture elsewhere says that God does not lie (Numbers 23:19; 1 Samuel 15:29), and it speaks of God sending deception on those who refuse the truth (Ezekiel 14:9; 2 Thessalonians 2:11). Whether Micaiah's account is a literal report of a heavenly scene or a vision cast in the picture of a royal council is not stated.

decisions.choice: a spirit of falsehood: a lying spirit
decisions.reason: "Falsehood" describes what the spirit produces: the prophets' words will be false. The phrase is repeated in verse 22.

decisions.choice: you will entice and also prevail: Yahweh's permission and promise of success
decisions.reason: Yahweh's reply grants the spirit's proposal and declares it will work, then sends it out.

decisions.choice: [him] / him
decisions.reason: English needs an object for "entice"; Literal brackets it.

decisions.choice: make all of Ahab's prophets tell lies
decisions.reason: Readable says plainly what "a lying spirit in the mouth of" the prophets means.

decisions.choice: "which is this, the way": a fuller form of the question in 1 Kings 22:24
decisions.reason: Chronicles adds "the way" to Zedekiah's question ("which is the way the Spirit of Yahweh passed ...?"), spelling out what Kings implies. The sense is the same, and so is the wording here.

decisions.choice: struck on the cheek: a public insult
decisions.reason: A slap on the cheek was an act of contempt and humiliation more than an attack to injure (Job 16:10; Lamentations 3:30; Micah 5:1).

decisions.choice: which way did the Spirit pass from me?: a mocking question
decisions.reason: Zedekiah claims that Yahweh's Spirit spoke through him, and scorns the idea that the Spirit could have left him to give Micaiah a different message. His words also echo Micaiah's vision, in which a spirit went out to speak through the prophets (verses 20-22).

decisions.choice: the Spirit of Yahweh: the power by which a prophet speaks
decisions.reason: Prophets spoke when Yahweh's Spirit came on them (Numbers 11:25-29; 1 Samuel 10:6, 10). Zedekiah claims this Spirit; Micaiah's vision has just told the king that a lying spirit was at work in these prophets.

decisions.choice: Do you really think ...?
decisions.reason: Readable brings out the scorn of the question (m3) instead of the "which way" pattern, which is hard to follow in plain English.

decisions.choice: the same order as 1 Kings 22:26
decisions.reason: The verse matches 1 Kings 22:26 except for small differences in the form of two verbs, and its wording here is the same.

decisions.choice: return him: send him back to those who had kept him
decisions.reason: "Return" suggests that Micaiah had been in the keeping of these officials before he was called, perhaps already under arrest.

decisions.choice: the official of the city: the governor of Samaria
decisions.reason: The word for an official or commander, with "of the city", names the officer in charge of the capital (2 Kings 23:8).

decisions.choice: the king's son: a royal son, or a title of a royal officer
decisions.reason: Joash may have been one of Ahab's sons. "The king's son" may also be the title of an officer who guarded prisoners (Jeremiah 36:26; 38:6).

decisions.choice: governor
decisions.reason: Every level says "governor", the clearest English for the officer in charge of a city (m3), rather than "prince" or "official".

decisions.choice: plural commands
decisions.reason: Here the king's orders are plural in Chronicles, where 1 Kings 22:26 has the singular (meaning decision: small differences in the form of two verbs); Spanish uses the plural, with the plural_you span.

decisions.choice: the wording of 1 Kings 22:26
decisions.reason: The Hebrew is that of 1 Kings 22:26 (m1), so each level keeps the Portuguese of 1 Kings word for word.

decisions.choice: bread of oppression and water of oppression: the meager rations of a prisoner
decisions.reason: "Oppression" describes hardship. The phrase means bare, reduced rations of bread and water (compare Isaiah 30:20).

decisions.choice: until I return in peace: until I come back safely
decisions.reason: The king assumes he will come back unharmed, which is exactly what Micaiah has denied. Micaiah takes up the words in verse 27.

decisions.choice: if you return in peace, Yahweh has not spoken by me: the test of a prophet
decisions.reason: The law gave this test: a prophecy that does not come true was not spoken by Yahweh (Deuteronomy 18:21-22). Micaiah stakes his standing as a prophet on the king's death.

decisions.choice: hear, peoples, all of them: the opening words of the book of Micah
decisions.reason: The same words begin the prophecy of Micah (Micah 1:2). Here they call everyone present to witness what Micaiah has said. The phrase is missing from the main ancient Greek translation of 1 Kings 22:28, and some think it was added there by a copier who linked Micaiah with the later prophet Micah; it is in the Hebrew text of both Kings and Chronicles.

decisions.choice: peoples: everyone present, or the nations
decisions.reason: "Peoples" usually means nations. Here it is a call to all who hear, to bear witness.

decisions.choice: he said to everyone there, "Remember what I have said!"
decisions.reason: Readable says what the call is for (m3, m4): those present are to witness the prophecy.

decisions.choice: the wording of 1 Kings 22:28
decisions.reason: The Hebrew is that of 1 Kings 22:28 (m1), so each level keeps the Portuguese of 1 Kings word for word.
